Peter Willis,

struggling economically.”

As corporate Dems fail to draw a substantial distinction, Bernie is
traveling the country to get out the vote, and we’re scaling up our
organizing in the critical swing states that will determine if MAGA
Republicans seize power or if we can build on our work to deliver for
working people.

We don’t want to wake up after Election Day to a reality where Bernie
Sanders is replaced as Chairman of the Senate Budget Committee by national
abortion ban author Lindsey Graham.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Our next phone banking opportunity is TODAY. _Will you join us?_

__**Make sure to bring your own device. You can bring a laptop, iPad, tablet or smart phone. Also, headphones will really help.**__

Voting officially begins in Washington State tomorrow! Peter,

Voting officially begins in Washington State tomorrow! I'm reaching out tonight because my team and I set a goal to raise $150,000 by midnight to ensure we stay on track in these final weeks, but we're still coming up a little short of our goal.

Control of the House majority hinges on the outcome of this race, so we can't afford to fall short.

Election experts are calling this race a "toss-up" and Republicans are spending $7 million to attack me. Reaching tonight's goal helps ensure we can respond to these attacks and reach voters across the 8th District before they return their ballots.

With less than three weeks left until Election Day, and in a race as close as this, we can't leave anything to chance. That's why I'm hoping I can count on your support to push us over the finish line before midnight so we can defend this seat and our Democratic House majority.

body:
It couldn’t be clearer how different Rubio and I are, but there’s a problem:

Fellow American,

I knew when I decided to run for office that my campaign would be met with support from a whole lot of folks, and I've been honored to see that support at hundreds of campaign stops across Georgia.

**But there are also racist bigots who want to demean me for the color of my skin and tear me apart because of my conservative viewpoints.**

I was attacked with racial slurs at a campaign event because I don't fit the Left's idea of what it means to be Black and conservative in America.

While I was holding a press conference in front of an apartment building owned by Raphael Warnock's church - which has attempted to evict residents for late rent payments **(sometimes for as little as $28)** , a protester in the crowd said of me:

| _**"He's a joke. He tap dances, and he's a house n*****."**_
---

The reporters who were covering our event said _**nothing**_.

The local reporters who were covering our event questioned **no one** , despite urgent pleas from my campaign staff to do so. Unfortunately, this doesn't surprise me because that's the mainstream media for you. If Fox News had not reported it, the protester would've gotten away with it in plain sight.

But there are also racist bigots who want to demean me for the color of my skin and tear me apart because of my conservative viewpoints. I was attacked with racial slurs at a campaign event because I don't fit the Left's idea of what it means to be Black and conservative in America. While I was holding a press conference in front of an apartment building owned by Raphael Warnock's church - which has attempted to evict residents for late rent payments (sometimes for as little as $28) , a protester in the crowd said of me: | "He's a joke. He tap dances, and he's a house n*." The reporters who were covering our event said nothing. The local reporters who were covering our event questioned no one , despite urgent pleas from my campaign staff to do so. Unfortunately, this doesn't surprise me because that's the mainstream media for you. If Fox News had not reported it, the protester would've gotten away with it in plain sight. Fellow American, it's sad this is the type of environment we're running in, but it's a pattern from the Left we've seen numerous times throughout this campaign. With early voting already underway, Tuesday's protester viciously attacked me for the color of my skin because I'm willing to STAND UP for my conservative values and SPEAK OUT for the truth. | | Dear Fellow American, Across the nation, parents are beginning to recognize the extent to which radical gender ideology, critical race theory and inappropriate classroom materials have permeated the K-12 education system. "_Woke_ " teachers who are motivated to indoctrinate young students have infiltrated schools all across America. These "educators" boldly brag about indoctrinating adolescent students with repulsive sexual ideologies and race theories on social media platforms like "Tik Tok," where parents have been witnessing this unsettling trend rapidly unfold. Students are being exposed to an epidemic of atrocious lessons and pornographic materials in schools every day, placed there deliberately by radicalized administrators and staff who are eager to shape and groom the sexual views of young children. **_We need to hear from you on this critical issue -_****_Please take our quick survey. _** **[What we are witnessing is dangerous predatory behavior against children. It must be exposed and stopped. The Faith & Freedom Coalition (FFC) has created a quick 3-question survey. We need your feedback right away. Please take a brief moment to answer our short educational survey now.](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)**
---
[**Take The Survey Now**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-zcpGnGQ)
---
As a result of toxic liberal policies, it is now legally permissible for a teacher to display obscene materials to minors without parental knowledge or consent. Teachers and counselors purposely keep this type of heinous information from parents. Graphic descriptions of all forms of sexual activities are made available to students in their classrooms, libraries, and sexual websites recommended by the schools. These sickening materials, **funded with _your_ tax-payer dollars**, are a direct assault on the mental, emotional, and spiritual health of children. It creates an environment where the 5-stages of sexual grooming can manifest with more ease. What is even more alarming is that school clinicians can now prescribe hormone altering medications and refer minors for surgical procedures without parental knowledge or permission \- _It is deeply disturbing. _ **_FFC believes parents have a fundamental right to know what their children are being exposed to in our schools - We need your input right away. _** **[Please take our brief 3-question survey so we can collect more information to use in the fight against inappropriate materials, horrific race theories, and sexual indoctrination in our children's classrooms.](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-NaDhn5qxdbCmVQ)**
---
[**Take The Survey Now**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace._n0fOCw)
---
The sad reality is, most young adults today are left uneducated about government, civics, and history. Instead of receiving an education, our children are being indoctrinated with harmful ultra-progressive ideology at a frightening rate. Our children have no chance at a proper education or normal life if the adults entrusted to educate our kids are corrupting them with shockingly inappropriate materials and ideology that will harm them mentally, emotionally, and spiritually **for the rest of their lives**. **Parents and concerned citizens must begin taking action - That's why we have created this brief 3-question Critical Education Survey for our readers.** **[Please take our quick critical survey now.](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)** Thank You & God Bless, Dr. Ralph ReedFounder & ChairmanFaith & Freedom Coalition

#
Friend of life,

As someone passionate to end abortion, you need to know what’s been going on the last few weeks.

Since Roe v. Wade was overturned, millions of dollars have been poured by donors into pro-abortion groups. They have one goal in mind: use this mountain of cash to fuel a landslide win for pro-abortion candidates this November.

Planned Parenthood and NARAL Pro-Choice America saw overall contributions increase from $630,000 to roughly $2.3 million in just three months. Every donation represents another baby in danger of death by abortion.

Meanwhile, pro-life groups across the country are struggling to keep up as donors have stopped giving. Too many people have viewed the end of Roe v. Wade as the end of the battle when it is just the beginning.

We need to activate courageous pro-life people before midnight tonight so we can stay in the fight and reach 34,000 moms before it’s too late. Will you take a stand with us? Give now: **[https://give.liveaction.org/fight-back/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47900%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oJwwkDD0o6iku3p%2b68r0VQ&sysid=1)**

Friend of Life - this is a David vs. Goliath battle.

We are up against a billion-dollar industry and lobby with the financial backing and support of the elites, the media, Hollywood, and higher education - and Planned Parenthood and its allies are increasing their spending and political action ahead of the mid-term elections.

Why?

Because they want to ensure that Americans reject the Court’s ruling on Roe v. Wade and expand abortion nationwide, rather than end it once and for all.

Polls show that Americans are increasing in their support of abortion-on-demand and even pro-life states could be on the verge of expanding abortion in the next few months. The 24/7 media barrage funded by committed pro-abortion donors is working and if we don’t move quickly, all of our progress over the last 40 years may disappear.

We have no time to lose and your gift RIGHT NOW will save babies from being poisoned, torn apart, and suctioned from their mother’s wombs: **[https://give.liveaction.org/fight-back/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47900%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oJwwkDD0o6iku3p%2b68r0VQ&sysid=1)**

Your unwavering conviction and commitment to this fight is why I have hope for our future. We will prevail in every state and overcome the horrific injustice of abortion as we spread the truth, one heart and one life at a time.

For life,

**Lila Rose**
Founder and President

subject: Get the truth about these 40 political myths
body:
There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z35f93g86kl1euqeng30d83gs9meqvo4vut91qg0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpgm6ob2chh2bs)

| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zss702q0ddh0nl72d5p9u4v5k2ql47me8o1uqavo_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpgm6ob2chh2bs)**

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

name: Pro Life Update
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhsu4gktuo8hu0gdl1sed3c34beans88ctd93640_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpgm6pb4c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9gfv29j3fdfokkifncpbe64t0gcp9aq63j1cn30_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpgm6pb4c1h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zt9cq5d4j1ljahpffiagr457e0icmm1ubcu2oo9g_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpgm6pb4c1h2bs)** Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! name: Ron DeSantis
subject: He's gaslighting the American public
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4187b9c9dee0dabe15671fbed951427ea9498e90a8fbafec0f04ecfa1ec718343cc70b2b329fa3d468a13f0c51bfa3c9d48acad84b12d66e435a9879b37351d3843d88e883abd8abb71b796d5351017f

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8b43136c8c1acd303e5d8745f5888e86456e43cd4da27fc22ece697b57ef19d9332d5e5108c0dfb86de8f8731146d1a3e4df7cabe7a3e895

Peter,

We all know locking kids out of school and disrupting their education for over a year, as blue state politicians did, was a terrible decision.

This week, Dr. Fauci had the audacity to claim he had nothing to do with school closures.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8b43136c8c1acd303e5d8745f5888e86456e43cd4da27fc22ece697b57ef19d9332d5e5108c0dfb86de8f8731146d1a3e4df7cabe7a3e895

As if working hand-in-glove with the teachers’ union bosses to cause the worst learning loss in decades wasn’t enough, the lockdown liberals’ idol Fauci is now gaslighting the American people.

Recent reports show devastating learning losses and achievement gaps in cities and states that kept students out of school for the longest. The effects of these disruptions will affect these young people for their entire lives. Make no mistake: Fauci’s ideology is to blame.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8b43136c8c1acd303e5d8745f5888e86456e43cd4da27fc22ece697b57ef19d9332d5e5108c0dfb86de8f8731146d1a3e4df7cabe7a3e895
REJECT FAUCIAN LOCKDOWNS

When you lock children out of school, there are going to be irreparable consequences – especially for our most vulnerable students. But power-hungry bureaucrats like Fauci weren’t worried about that. They thought nothing about sacrificing the future of our children for their political agenda.

Fauci and his acolytes are trying to rewrite history, while children suffer the consequences.

If the Left had their way, Florida students would be facing the same fate as kids in lockdown states.

Now, they are beginning to see just how badly they harmed children and are desperately trying to disassociate themselves from their draconian lockdowns. Not because they regret their shameful treatment of students, but because their past policy has fallen out of political favor.

They didn’t care about our kids then and they certainly don’t now, Peter.

They care about what puts them in the best position politically. They never followed the data. They followed the checkbook of their woke mega donors.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8b43136c8c1acd303e5d8745f5888e86456e43cd4da27fc22ece697b57ef19d9332d5e5108c0dfb86de8f8731146d1a3e4df7cabe7a3e895
COUNTER THE LEFT'S OUT-OF-TOUCH DONORS

Frankly, Peter, this is all a bunch of COVID theater.

Fauci and the extreme Left were happy to impose these authoritarian edicts to prolong the misery and suffering they have caused. They want to exercise unchecked power over the people they were never elected to govern.

Their only goal is to take decisions out of your hands and force you to comply with their orders. All they want is power and control over your lives.

But I can tell you this, as long as I am your Governor, your freedoms will always be protected.

In Florida, we foresaw the very real consequences of locking children out of the classroom. We realized the cruelty of denying children an education and fought to keep our classrooms open five days a week.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8b43136c8c1acd303e5d8745f5888e86456e43cd4da27fc22ece697b57ef19d9332d5e5108c0dfb86de8f8731146d1a3e4df7cabe7a3e895
HELP KEEP FLORIDA FREE

I received backlash for keeping schools open and kids in the classroom, namely from Fauci and teachers’ union leaders. But unlike the Left, I didn’t base my decision as this state’s leader on political science. I based it on the future of our students.

As a result, Florida students are outperforming their counterparts in other states across the board.

There's a reason why we're known as the free state of Florida: We protected your freedoms, made sure kids were in school five days a week, made sure businesses could operate, and people could go to church.

Now, the extreme Left is attempting to bring their failed agenda to Florida.

We cannot allow that to happen, Peter.

I’m fighting around the clock to make sure we keep Florida the freest state in the nation, but I need your help.

Our freedom is on the line, and if the Left gets their way, our rights will be stripped away one by one.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8b43136c8c1acd309b6285ce464a2b8136cbacaa069f854b26786167fc19d4bc5b618215fb9f2440ba4d1ef432c140df4ef49aff4f127be2
>>">Can I count on your immediate support today to make sure we keep our kids in school, our businesses open, and our ability to practice our faith without Left-wing tyranny? >>>

In freedom,
Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8b43136c8c1acd303e5d8745f5888e86456e43cd4da27fc22ece697b57ef19d9332d5e5108c0dfb86de8f8731146d1a3e4df7cabe7a3e895

name: Candace Owens
subject: I’ve received death threats… here’s why
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61701100:6NSmMRVNn:m:1:3317145305:4625D2EF6139ED47507482EEE104ACFC:r)

Hello Peter,

I've dealt with racism before. . . I've even received death threats.

All because I am a Black woman with conservative values and because I believe that Black communities can overcome the victimhood mentality.

I've watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence for almost my entire life. Growing up, I remember being told I was "helpless."

This message -- which the media forces Black Americans to listen to -- is heartbreaking. _And it needs to stop_.

I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Brandon Tatum to promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthen the nuclear family, and foster a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

Our message to America's Black and minority communities is, _**" You don't have to be a victim."**_

[_**Will you please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission by helping me reach our goal of raising $50,000 from new online donors this month? You can **__**click here to donate >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61701100:6NSmMRVNn:m:1:3317145305:4625D2EF6139ED47507482EEE104ACFC:r)

Black communities are taught to believe that we're victims, that nothing will ever change, that police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG! Giving up and becoming a victim is never the solution.

It's why BLEXIT is NOT just a "think tank," but a thoughtful and quick-acting "DO-tank." _**That 's all thanks to our BLEXIT State Chapters. **_

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the movement at the local, grassroots level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

Since 2019, BLEXIT has grown to reach 42 states with over 14,000 volunteers.

Peter, I am humbly asking you to support BLEXIT and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $50,000 this week to support our mission.

[_**Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61701100:6NSmMRVNn:m:1:3317145305:4625D2EF6139ED47507482EEE104ACFC:r)

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values.

BLEXIT Chapters promote and encourage others to seek alternative educational opportunities in their local communities. Educational opportunities for America's low-income and minority children and empower them to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_
](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61701100:6NSmMRVNn:m:1:3317145305:4625D2EF6139ED47507482EEE104ACFC:r)
* Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers, and this ugly message is setting Black Americans back.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice.

BLEXIT Chapter members lead educational programs to help communities avoid incarceration and foster better relationships between police officers and urban communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61701100:6NSmMRVNn:m:1:3317145305:4625D2EF6139ED47507482EEE104ACFC:r)

* Entrepreneurship: Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not just talking a big game. . . Our Chapter members are actually connecting with community individuals to make a real impact in urban communities.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61701100:6NSmMRVNn:m:1:3317145305:4625D2EF6139ED47507482EEE104ACFC:r)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. Our urban communities must learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens.

It's why BLEXIT holds summer and after-school programs to teach children about these important lessons.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61701100:6NSmMRVNn:m:1:3317145305:4625D2EF6139ED47507482EEE104ACFC:r)

* Presenting Our Message: The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. These are urban communities that others ignore, communities that rely on the mainstream media to write their narrative.

These aren't boring events, and we're not just preaching to the choir. They have music, art, and real conversations. Most importantly, they are fun!

These exciting events are brought to life because of our State Chapters. Their hard work and creativity help our message reach new people and inspires communities to be victors, not victims.

[_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61701100:6NSmMRVNn:m:1:3317145305:4625D2EF6139ED47507482EEE104ACFC:r)

This is personal to me -- I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood, but now I found my exit.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice.

BLEXIT Chapter members lead educational programs to help communities avoid incarceration and foster better relationships between police officers and urban communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61701091:JHnyMRVNS:m:1:3253819041:5CE520C4366AF62D1304EA0513C7501D:r)

subject: Victor Davis Hanson on DVD
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=55572227b0e640bb9c43509a13171ae3&_e=lCkt6XpkETIjHhFkZoxR7zxY691JNCAk66jDq9hGBV-CIoauuy_e5zWjn9FFjC6qSk3rOrjfFRme8agpQf4p6WvlLcp66t8TfOIy6clBpMHlByHlWNHPj_9bPv4DhozrMcZjSUuQ_O22stDSmu4FGVPgT1dbiI8urF3gTrFDs3MqJ3VriBhNNDGoYQyWQbteydiHF0oNaMXb-FF_BksrGYmM8yQVoVRM6wYs5yU1s3L0ONAzUiLr_9lnf58LHox6pm0qeqmppt-wRb0yz9cUK_U46oUngIl5OT7_2fHM-vGQtSIzhJYN4Papu_qpW8Aa6ppnaLlYib2OaEjEelnvCsI5j7db3ounfDsPZdAxcRk_L4OjGKgYPMFH7nlLBQcb5h4Brn8DaT4rJkXuxQPpRg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Peter,
Last night, my MAGA Republican opponent Andy Ogles had a telephone rally with Donald Trump. Ever since he squeaked through the Republican Primary, Ogles has been begging his idol, Donald Trump, to support him and he finally got his wish — an 8-minute public phone call.
On the call, Ogles doubled down on his obsession with Trump (even though Trump first endorsed someone else in the GOP Primary).
Then when Trump finally spoke, he attacked, calling me an “extremist.”
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/holler%20tweet.png]
It’s not extreme to stand up for what is right for families in Middle Tennessee. It’s not extreme to believe billionaires should pay their fair share in taxes so we can invest in schools, affordable healthcare, and strengthening Social Security.
I’ve run tough campaigns before, so I know when they bring out the big guns, even a one-term president, it’s proof that what we’re doing is working and they’re scared.
I don’t believe in idolatry and I will not bow down to Trump or anyone else in Washington. I will answer to the people of Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District, and that’s exactly why we’re going to win in 18 days.
In the coming days, we will be making some of our final TV ad buys. Will you chip in to help fully fund our ad budget so we can communicate with voters across the district? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellemail]

Friends, **Tonight is the first and only debate in the race for New Mexico’s 2nd congressional district.** It’s a major opportunity for me to share our campaign’s message with the voters and go toe-to-toe with my far-right opponent Yvette Herrell on our stances. As we already know, Herrell is an anti-choice MAGA extremist who wants to ban abortion nationwide, even in cases of rape, incest, or the life of the mother. She’s an election-denier who used her first vote in Congress to try and overturn the 2020 election results. And she’s voted against bills that would help New Mexicans — like lower prescription drug prices, a higher minimum wage, and better health care for veterans — at every turn. **Unlike Herrell, I won’t prioritize pushing an extreme agenda or looking out for corporate interests. My #1 priority is to fight for you, the people.** When elected to Congress, I will always defend a woman’s right to choose, protect our environment and public lands, help raise wages and lower costs, and make healthcare more affordable. And I will never try to overturn the will of the people by denying election results. **The pundits and polls are saying we CAN flip this toss-up seat from red to blue in November and help hold the House majority. With just 17 short days left until one of the most critical elections in Pennsylvania history, it's never been more important to make your voice heard. | | |

| | Dear Peter, **With just 17 short days left until one of the most critical elections in Pennsylvania history, it's never been more important to make your voice heard.** Pennsylvania Republicans are working hard to elect extremists into the two highest offices of Pennsylvania. Not only did Doug Mastriano cross police barriers at the January 6th insurrection, he also recruited followers from a white supremacist website. Meanwhile, Mehmet Oz spent the last 30 years of his life living in a mansion _in New Jersey_ and constantly demonstrates his ignorance of the real-life experience of working families. **We can't trust people like Mastriano, Oz, and their supporters to represent our interests. That's why we have to make our voices heard, and that starts with making a plan to vote.** If you aren’t registered to vote yet, [take a minute to register online or check your voter registration status](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53044441/374213965/-231314603?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ3MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTEwMDkwYi01MTUxLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p1wZuVqp21V1uXUpMiOw060aj_sYmK5o8WYeHtVz_N4=&emci=549b7dc5-ab50-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=2910090b-5151-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=25616296). **The voter registration deadline is this Monday, October 24. But don’t stop there! Text your friends, nieces, grandkids to make sure they’re also registered. ** If you plan to [vote early in person](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53044442/374213966/-796020058?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ3MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTEwMDkwYi01MTUxLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p1wZuVqp21V1uXUpMiOw060aj_sYmK5o8WYeHtVz_N4=&emci=549b7dc5-ab50-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=2910090b-5151-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=25616296), you can request your ballot at your county election office, vote, and turn it in all at once until 5 PM, November 1. [Find the location of your county election office here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53044443/374213967/1309784056?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ3MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTEwMDkwYi01MTUxLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p1wZuVqp21V1uXUpMiOw060aj_sYmK5o8WYeHtVz_N4=&emci=549b7dc5-ab50-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=2910090b-5151-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=25616296) Voting by mail is also an easy and accessible way to vote. [Request your mail-in ballot online or by paper application](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53044444/374213968/-1062847730?refcode=site21_vote&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ3MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTEwMDkwYi01MTUxLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p1wZuVqp21V1uXUpMiOw060aj_sYmK5o8WYeHtVz_N4=&emci=549b7dc5-ab50-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=2910090b-5151-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=25616296) before 5 PM, November 1, but we encourage you to request it as soon as possible to ensure your ballot is returned before 8 PM on Election Day. Election Day is November 8, and in-person voting will be available at your polling location from 7 AM to 8 PM. [Confirm your polling place](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53044445/374213969/88266837?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ3MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTEwMDkwYi01MTUxLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p1wZuVqp21V1uXUpMiOw060aj_sYmK5o8WYeHtVz_N4=&emci=549b7dc5-ab50-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=2910090b-5151-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=25616296) ahead of time. Be sure to take your ID if it's your first time voting at that location. **Remember that no matter how you vote, your ballot must be RECEIVED no later than 8 PM on November 8 to be counted. Postmarked dates are not considered.** Take a screenshot of these deadlines or add these dates to your calendar to remind yourself!

body:
This is how we can build an economy that works for everyone, not just the folks at the top. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53045135/374216173/-1088599557?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221021_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NDBiZmRmOS01MTUxLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kh_Kyg7weDxOEfgZEMpM4PjNcQF3jP494eD9jw94-Xs=) Last week, I joined the _Pod Save America_ podcast to talk about our race and my plans to build an economy that grows for everyone, not just the top 10%. We also talked about the pain too many Americans are feeling right now — that no matter how hard they work, they struggle to get ahead. **The truth is that our economy is tilted in favor of the wealthy and well connected, and we need to make working people a priority again.** Here are some steps I laid out on the Pod:
1. We need to reverse the Trump Tax Cuts that delivered huge tax breaks to those at the very top, while leaving hardworking families further behind.

2. We need to give tax cuts to working people — like reinstating the expanded _Child Tax Credit_ , which cut child poverty in half last year, and passing the earned income tax credit, which helps workers that don’t have children.

3. We need to pass more policies like those in the _CHIPS Act_ and _Inflation Reduction Act_ — policies that bring manufacturing jobs back to America and strengthen our supply chains.

4. We need to invest in renewable energies that will create jobs, lower costs, and reduce emissions for all Coloradans.

**I know we can make America a better place — a place of more opportunity — for every single American. I know it because we’ve already begun.**
Together, we secured historic investments in Colorado’s roads, bridges, and waterways. We cut childhood poverty in half by passing the _Child Tax Credit_. We made the largest federal investment ever in reducing America’s climate emissions, and we passed the first bipartisan gun reform in decades.
**You, me, and my Democratic colleagues are getting things done and making things better. We can’t allow Republicans to roll that progress back.** We need to protect and expand our Democratic Senate majority.

We also talked about the pain too many Americans are feeling right now — that no matter how hard they work, they struggle to get ahead. The truth is that our economy is tilted in favor of the wealthy and well connected, and we need to make working people a priority again. Here are some steps I laid out on the Pod: 1. We need to reverse the Trump Tax Cuts that delivered huge tax breaks to those at the very top, while leaving hardworking families further behind. 2. We need to give tax cuts to working people — like reinstating the expanded Child Tax Credit , which cut child poverty in half last year, and passing the earned income tax credit, which helps workers that don’t have children. 3. We need to pass more policies like those in the CHIPS Act and Inflation Reduction Act — policies that bring manufacturing jobs back to America and strengthen our supply chains. 4. We need to invest in renewable energies that will create jobs, lower costs, and reduce emissions for all Coloradans. | | = I know we can make America a better place — a place of more opportunity — for every single American. body:
Friends,
We took back the House in 2018 thanks to the bold, brilliant women who stepped up to run for Congress in record numbers.
But with the midterms in under three weeks, many of these very same women are being massively outspent by the GOP and dark money groups in their purple districts. They’re at serious risk of losing their seats—and with them, our House majority.
I know it can be difficult to decide where to invest your resources in the final stretch of the campaign. So today, I am urging you to support three of these outstanding women in toss-up House races where your support can still seriously move the needle: Rep. Sharice Davids (Kansas-03), Rep. Angie Craig (Minnesota-02), and Rep. Kim Schrier (Washington-08). [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/ots_ks_sd_ac?refcode=jtk3726-fr-nd]
Sharice, Angie and Kim are neck-and-neck in purple districts with affordable media markets. That means your dollar makes a HUGE difference when it comes to getting ads on the air and reaching voters. (They also happen to be my teammates on the Congressional Women’s Softball team—I can tell you firsthand that Sharice, Angie and Kim are the real deal).
It’s simple. We cannot afford to lose Sharice, Angie and Kim’s voices in Congress. Please: Will you invest in these three campaigns today and save our House majority? [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/ots_ks_sd_ac?refcode=jtk3726-fr-nd]
Let me take a moment to share a bit more about each of these outstanding members of Congress—and why they deserve your support.
Rep. Sharice Davids [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/ots_ks_sd_ac?refcode=jtk3726-fr-nd] is a member of the Ho-Chunk Nation and an expert in Native American community and economic development. The first LGBTQ Kansan elected to Congress, Sharice is a model for other LGBTQ leaders running in red districts across the country. Against the odds, she defeated her hard-line opponent’s anti-choice ballot measure this August. The latest polls still show this race as a toss up— with your support, we can build on the Democratic momentum in Kansas and hold this seat. name: Admiral Mike Franken
subject: Fox News puts our troops in jeopardy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221021 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221021]
Will you split a donation between Admiral Mike Franken's campaign and Seth Moulton today and do your part to flip Iowa from red to blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221021]
Friend,
As bombs began raining down on Ukrainian cities, Donald Trump called into Fox News to blame – you guessed it – Joe Biden and Hillary Clinton.
As Russian tanks began pouring over the Ukrainian border, Fox News host Laura Ingraham had the gall to call Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy “pathetic.”
And if you tune into Tucker Carlson these days, you’ll see a show that might as well have been written and produced by Russian state media. Fox News showcases the chasm between traditional GOP normative behavior and the fringe-right cabal now headed by Donald J. Trump.
As the commander of military forces in East Africa, I asked the American Forces Network to replace Fox News during meal hours for troops. Why? Because they were harmful to America's outreach overseas. They put our troops in jeopardy and made my job harder.
Without Fox News, Trump would have only ever been a bungling celebrity who foolishly and laughably ran for president.
Real-time reckoning of lies needs real-time litigation. There is such a thing as gross distortions of fact and purveyors of such must pay a debilitating price. My answer to Fox when I was an admiral in the U.S. Navy? I pulled the plug.
When I defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, I will be the most senior military person ever elected to the United States Senate. And I think it’s about time we had more people in leadership who understand the true costs of war and media manipulation of facts, commonly called disinformation.
The polls show we can win. The pundits say we must win. And with your help today, we can fight back against McConnell’s Super PAC lies and protect our Democratic majority in the Senate.
We’ve set a goal of raising another $100,000 before midnight, but right now, we’re still short. If we’re going to defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to give now:
Please, will you split a donation of $27 or more right now between my campaign and Seth Moulton – whatever you can afford before midnight tonight – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221021]
Fox News’ propaganda cannot go unanswered. But it takes significant funding to run a full-scale campaign and take on all of Grassley’s and McConnell’s lies.
I’m not taking a dime of corporate PAC money, so whatever you can give today will go a long way.
I am so thankful to have you on the team,
Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.)
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221021]

| Hi ,
I wanted to make sure you are aware that this Sunday, Gavin Newsom and I will be debating live!

Mark your calendars - we will be live this Sunday, October 23rd, at 1 PM.

**[Watch The Debate Here - Sunday at 1pm. ](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=80855a993a&e=f9133ea432)**

With ballots now in hand, Californians will be asking themselves one important question:

**What did Gavin Newsom do for me in the last 4 years as Governor?**

If you’re as curious as I am as to what Gavin has to say for himself, then tune in on Sunday.

Rest assured - I’ll be presenting the facts.

In the last four years...
* **Our crime rate skyrocketed.**
* **Gas prices more than doubled. **
* **People left our state in mass exodus because they couldn’t afford to live here.**
* **Our children’s education standards sunk to nearly the lowest in the nation. **

[Again, here's where you can watch and listen to the debate Sunday at 1pm. ](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=8bb2e8209b&e=f9133ea432)

Lastly, I want to let you know that it is **absolutely crucial** that you get involved at this stage of the campaign.

We won’t be able to get out our message of hope in time before November 8th if we don’t have the funding.

Can you help us?

We desperately need you to help with donations so we can cross the finish line.

| | Derek, Like many Americans, I’ve become increasingly concerned with Big Tech’s power over our economy, our private data, and how we use the internet. It’s something I’ve been working on for several years now in the Senate, starting with the investigation into Russian election interference. We uncovered serious problems with misinformation and pressured companies like Facebook to make important transparency reforms. It continued following the _Dobbs_ decision, when we discovered that Google misled people searching for abortion clinics, sending women to non-medical organizations that try to convince them to go through with their unwanted pregnancies. As I'm writing you this email, I've been traveling from one rally to the next and just got back on the campaign bus. With only 18 days left before Election Day, I'm visiting every single corner of Florida – from the Panhandle to the Keys. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53047627/374225486/-1927214015?amount=20&refcode=EM_NBI_DWSPAC_20221021_FR_1.2_0_3MO_splitdemings_NA_NA_rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzkvMS84ODcwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NDRhODUyZS01NjUxLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qLkv4lGG_tHYoU0CjPgSGJm8ENOXz6C1xNnJEpox9mU=)

Here's what I tell them: I think about the hardworking families like mine who deserve a leader that understands their lives, their struggles and their dreams. I think about our country's need to expand our Democratic Senate majority to protect our democracy.

And, in the background of all of this, I hear my mother's voice in my head telling me, "Never tire of doing good, Val."

That's what energizes me as I travel to all 67 counties of Florida to surge ahead in this race. I know winning this race will make a meaningful difference for Florida – and for our country – but polls show me neck and neck with Marco Rubio right now.

That's why I'm asking for your support in the final stretch of my campaign. Unlike Marco Rubio, my average donation is just $29.04, so I rely on people like you to help me fund voter outreach and move forward in these final few weeks.

I'm about to hop off the bus at my next campaign event, so I have to ask: If you believe in this campaign and want to help me defend our Democratic Senate majority, will you donate $20 to me and Democrats Win Seats today? Here's the best link to contribute:

name: Ken Burns
subject: Never have I felt such a threat to our democracy
body:
Derek,
I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
That’s why I’m reaching out. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in New Hampshire.
Maggie Hassan is a vital voice in the Senate, and we cannot afford to lose her tireless work on behalf of Granite Staters—and in fact all Americans. This November, she's up against a far-right election denier who believes a woman’s most personal decisions about abortion—decisions about her own body—belong in the hands of Republican “gentlemen” lawmakers.
Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. Either we plunge down the path of extremism that Maggie's opponent has taken, or we choose the other way—the higher road—and come together to support leaders like Maggie who will fight to protect our future.
Maggie won her last race by just 1,017 votes. That was one of the closest margins in American history. And Republicans are targeting her race with almost $60 million in attack ads. With under three weeks left until the election, we need to have the resources necessary to turn out every last vote.
So I'm asking you now, Derek: will you help meet this moment by splitting a donation between Maggie Hassan and CommonGood today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221021_CGVA_Hassan]

| | |

Team –

Earlier this week, I debated Marco Rubio in our one and only chance before Election Day, and I wanted to take a minute to say thank you.

Thank you for dreaming of a better America with me: an America where reproductive rights are protected, voting rights are expanded and gun violence is prevented.

Thank you for believing that a poor Black girl from the South can grow up to run in one of the most competitive Senate races in the country.

Thank you for helping us build the strongest Senate campaign that Florida has ever seen – a movement made up of over 650,000 grassroots supporters who believe, like you do, that it’s time to retire Rubio and give Florida the representation it needs.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53051176/374238923/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk385-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNGIzOWYxZi01YTUxLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ChRo0NpvvOFt8tzGQefxBXR9nxJgRBoqvLhf8ecyIOw=) Peter – I was born in a time when abortion was illegal.**But no one has been born in a time when abortions didn't _happen_.**

Despite the intricate web of bans across America that had been spun over the decades before, thousands of women still sought abortions every year. But, instead of receiving the care they needed in an exam room, they were forced to turn to dangerous, unregulated procedures or self-administered efforts, often in moments of desperation. Safer abortions under the supervision of a doctor were limited to the wealthiest women who had the connections and resources required – but even they were forced into secrecy. **As a nurse and a mother, I understand that abortion can be genuinely lifesaving – but in the world I grew up in, it could also be deadly.**
That's why Roe v. Wade was so transformative – it gave us all the freedom to safely and independently make choices about our futures, our bodies, and our health without interference or mandated bans from political leaders. It's impossible to count the number of lives saved by that single ruling.
For decades, I felt confident that my kids and my grandkids would grow up with more rights and freedoms than I did.** But now the dangerous, radical decision by this Supreme Court to overturn Roe v. Wade has s****et our country back decades, undermined the will of the American people, and put every single right that we care about at risk.**
**In the wake of this ruling, my opponent Eric Schmitt made Missouri the first state to enact a so-called trigger ban.** Under this law, abortions at ANY stage of pregnancy are banned – and performing an abortion is a felony punishable by up to 15 years in prison. We're seeing laws like this pop up all across the country, and they're getting increasingly extreme. Far-right legislators here even tried to ban people leaving Missouri from getting an abortion elsewhere.
I refuse to sit idly by as I watch my state and my country go backward. That's why I'm working my heart out to defeat Eric Schmitt and stop him from taking his far-right ideology to the U.S. Senate. **You have my word on this: If you send me to Washington, I will proudly be _the_ vote that we need to codify abortion access into law once and for all.**
**[We're in the fight of our lives here, Peter. If you're willing to fight with me, will you make a $5 donation to help me flip Missouri blue and ensure that future generations have the freedom to choose? subject: Our Liberties are Under Attack
disclaimer_text: paid for by Nathaniel Moran for Congress
body:
As a liberty-loving American, I am appalled by the Biden administration’s attacks on the freedoms we hold dear. |
---
| |
---
| | Fellow East Texan,

As a liberty-loving American, I am appalled by the Biden administration’s attacks on the freedoms we hold dear. From using the Department of Justice as a political militia to targeting parents as “domestic terrorists,” Democrats have abused their power and attempted to silence critics to avoid accountability. I want to go to Congress to hold this administration and its co-conspirators accountable. We must preserve our Constitutional freedoms for all Americans.

I have a proven history of fighting for our Constitutional rights. As County Judge, I presided over Smith County becoming a **2nd Amendment Sanctuary County**. And I fought back (and won!) against Planned Parenthood to **preserve the lives of the unborn** when the Heartbeat Bill was under attack here in Smith County. As a lawyer, I **defended our religious liberties** by providing free legal services for people whose religious beliefs were under attack.

No administration should pick and choose which freedoms it will preserve. Please help send me to Congress so I can continue the fight for liberty in Washington, D.C. **Can I count on your vote and support?**

Sincerely,
---
|
---
| Nathaniel Moran
Republican for U.S. Congress, TX-1

body:
it's time to do everything we can to ensure our message is top of mind for voters as they make their decisions

Hi Derek – Chrissy here.

Yesterday, Shane sent you a message about our second campaign ad of this cycle, "One Chip at a Time." This ad is very special to me because it highlights my work to improve supply chains and lower costs by helping pass the CHIPS and Science Act.
---
Now, we are well on our way to bringing more manufacturing jobs to Pennsylvania, fixing supply chains, and lowering prices for families. And thanks to your support, we've been able to spread this message to voters in PA-06.
But we're less than three weeks away from Election Day and mail-in ballots are already being sent in, so it's time to do everything we can to ensure our message is top of mind for voters as they make their decisions. Everything we do between now and then will determine whether or not we reach the victory line. That's why I need your help.

**Derek, will you donate $5 now to keep our ads on air and power our campaign to victory? You can watch "One Chip at a Time" and donate online here:**

[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/houlahan-onechip**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53052510/374244491/1540140954?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk725-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMmJmNzU5OS01ZDUxLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1ikz4B0JXHXFoSzAjA56k1Prrnl5Rkfpq80EviqdRFY=)

name: Josh Harder
subject: I find this disgusting
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Harder for Congress |
body:
Peter,

A few days ago my opponent Tom Patti called himself the “Antichrist to the leftist agenda” because he’s a “white Christian heterosexual male.”

I’ve had some time to reflect on why these comments hit me so hard and I wanted to share my thoughts.

I love my home here in the Valley. We’re a wonderful diverse community that looks out for each other. People are much more likely to ask me in the grocery story about Lillian than they are anything political. Politics doesn’t divide us like it does in some other communities.

And that’s why it’s so hurtful my opponent uses this kind of rhetoric.

It only takes one person with a large microphone to change how people view themselves and their community. It seeps into our psyches and turns neighbor against neighbor.

All this is to say, this campaign isn’t just about policy differences. Or even which party controls Congress. This race, to me, is about saving what makes my home feel like home. And I’d argue this rhetoric over time will also come for our country too. Maybe it already has.

If you believe we need to cut this destructive rhetoric off at its roots, I hope you’ll consider chipping into my race. We have 20 days left.

Josh

Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
A brand-new poll from the gold-standard Des Moines Register shows I am only THREE points behind Grassley polls, so of course, I’m facing millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.

disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate

_Gabby and me during her recovery_
Friends —
When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system around me to help me through.
Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.
Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.
Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.
Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.
But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.
In combat, I had my wingmen.
With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.
And in these campaigns, I have you.
I could not do this without you. You probably didn't wake up this morning thinking you’d make a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat my Republican opponent and hold this seat.

name: Gavin Newsom
subject: Please give me a chance to explain
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
It’s well known that nearly every industry is held to account when their products cause harm or injury. Except one.
#

Friends -
In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution directly to Giffords PAC. Please give me a chance to explain why this request, especially today, is so important.
Here is the truth:
It’s well known that nearly every industry is held to account when their products cause harm or injury.
Except one.
The gun industry.
They’ve spent millions of dollars over the years buying up politicians to shield themselves from the pain they cause in our communities.
In California, we changed that. I signed a bill allowing Californians to sue irresponsible gun manufacturers or distributors.
But we need Congress to act as well.
Not just to hold an irresponsible gun industry accountable, but to take commonsense measures like passing universal background checks.
According to Giffords Law Center, in 2021 California was ranked as the TOP STATE in the nation for gun safety. Our commonsense laws have allowed us to decrease our gun death rate by half. That means safer communities and more lives saved.
We know the steps Congress can take to make our communities safer, and Giffords is leading the fight to get it done. Please help them today.

I say what I’m going to do, and then I deliver. It’s what I’ve been doing my entire career because I care about the people I represent—whether they’re Democrats, Republicans, or don’t vote at all.

* While JD was writing a book blaming the working class for their economic struggles, _I was working to make sure Ohio kids had access to healthy food._

* While JD was in San Francisco enjoying “tasty brunches, day trips to wine country, and art gallery tours,” _I was fighting to protect workers’ pensions._

* While JD was running a scammy, self-serving opioid nonprofit, _I was introducing legislation to increase access to addiction treatment._

The voter registration deadline is just days away, . Stay informed and feel confident about casting your ballot with these Pennsylvania Election Resources and Guides [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1glh_1xQTxIryK0MHrlFuy04HNqptd9fPiCuoxZvRChY/edit] created by Commonwealth Communications. This roundup has everything you need to know about the November 8th election, including poll worker information, insight on the Governor's race, county/district specific voter guides, and more.

October 24, 2022: Last day to REGISTER to vote in the November 8 election. ***Three days away***
November 1, 2022: Last day to apply for a mail-in or civilian absentee ballot.
November 8, 2022: Election Day! Last day for County Boards of Elections to receive vote by mail and civilian absentee ballots (must be received by 8:00 P.M.)
Get Out The Vote with Team NPP
The New Pennsylvania Project has registered more than 18,000 new voters in 2022! We need all hands on deck to be sure every single newly registered voter casts their ballot in the November midterm election!
GOTV Midterm 2022 Volunteer Sign up [https://secure.everyaction.com/yYUljXpOSU6uWF8ytWbEWw2]
Sign, date, and don’t be late!
Sign, date, and seal. Deliver only your ballot to a county election office or drop box in your county.
You can mail it as well, but please do so before November 1st to ensure timely delivery.
Find a drop box [https://vote.pa/return/]
Find your county election office [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Resources/Pages/Contact-Your-Election-Officials.aspx]
FYI: Voters with a disability can designate someone to return their ballot for them.

# **Newsletter-October 21 Vol. 2, #35**
---
| | |
##
21 October 22

**17 Days Until Election Day!**

Mail-In Ballots are now in the hands of voters and voting has begun. Early voting begins in 6 days (Oct 27-Nov 3). We have a lot of work to do! We need your help to get America back on course.

For the first time in 35 years we have an opportunity to make a REAL difference in District 4. Please seize THIS moment!

The campaign had a GREAT turnout and a great response at the Laurel parade last weekend. The enthusiasm is inspiring.

**Radio Ads**
Radio Ads will begin next week until election day on WIHT (Hot 99.5), WAVA (105.1) and WMAL (105.9).
The [30 second generic ad](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=bf69d3eabc&e=12a37459a2) and the [60 sec faith-based ad](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=3c163afb5a&e=12a37459a2) are attached. Please share them freely with the appropriate audiences.

**Sign Waving**
This Saturday, October 22
Noon-1p
The intersection of Branch Ave & Allentown Rd.
Park at Royal Farms parking lot
6210 Allentown Rd, Camp Springs, 20748
FREE JW4C T-shirt provided for those who have not yet received one.
If you have a JW4C T-shirt, please wear it.
Be sure to bring your water bottle.

**Signage**
More signs are going up in the key precincts. We need help to get more signs out...this includes yard signs.
Yard Signs are FREE, yet we are requesting a minimum $10 donation, if you're in a position to donate.
Please contact us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

**Leave Jeff Warner's Pre-Recorded Message To Voters**
The phone calling team is amazing! 32,368 voters have been contacted as of today! Way To Go Team!
Contact Val for the 15 minute training.
443-386-8303

**Final Donations** We are so grateful for the sacrificial support. As we near the end, please consider making a generous contribution. The maximum contribution is $2900 per person. Your donation will help us boost our radio ads and texting. This is especially crucial since Facebook is _discontinuing_ political ads beginning November 1 which is one of the most critical weeks of the campaign.
**Social Media**
Don't miss some of the amazing stories on social media @RepJeffWarner.

**Prayer and Fasting**
If you pray and/or fast, we are asking you to join us in asking God for His perfect will to be done. Please join us on Mondays or whenever works best for you.

We are asking you for your donations, for your service, and your prayers. Together, we can do this! This is the power of teamwork! And the Best Is Yet To Come! Please reach out to us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

In 2 weeks, the General Election counting will be in process. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=ba4681b7f0&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

He said that, “as a man,” he believed **a woman’s most personal decisions about their bodies belonged to “gentlemen”** state legislators.

Hi Derek, it's John Fetterman.

**_With crime rates skyrocketing across the nation and families less safe than ever, it's time to face the facts. _**
_Democrats' soft-on-crime policies are dangerous - and destroying cities like New York._

Defund-the-Police Democrats have demonized law enforcement, emboldened dangerous criminals and implemented radical reforms like **eliminating cash bail.**

New York's far-left Attorney General Letitia James championed an anti-police platform when she was first elected -_but is changing her tune as_ _[violent crime spikes](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=0a0f73722e&e=edf8a4d16d) and her [poll numbers plummet.](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=08ca209f99&e=edf8a4d16d)_

name: Julia DeGraw
subject: URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Regulate air pollution from dairy farms!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters and authorized by Andrea Salinas for Congress
body:
| |
---
| | Dear Peter, Everyone deserves clean air, and dairy factory farms must be held accountable for their air pollution. That's why we’re working with our partner groups in the Stand Up to Factory Farms coalition, which filed a petition urging the Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) to regulate air emissions from large dairy factory farms in Oregon. **[Will you stand up to Big Ag and send a message to the DEQ urging them to regulate dairy farm emissions and in turn, reduce air pollution in Oregon?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53068947/374284776/1120709316?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjUxZTc3NWUzLTczNTEtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ms5s5L10vht0C5WB9vDTVaCjsNo6gO2XkCQyb3EBcKw=&emci=59f56a9d-d250-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=51e775e3-7351-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=2107230)** Large dairy factory farms pollute our air, warm our climate, and threaten our health. Have you ever driven past a dairy farm and wrinkled your nose in disgust at the foul smell that lingers in the air around these farms? That’s because they’re fueling climate change by emitting huge amounts of methane and damaging the air quality for communities surrounding these farms. These farms also produce toxic air pollutants like ammonia that can cause chronic respiratory issues and even death. The Department of Environmental Quality is currently accepting public comment on this petition to manage emissions from large dairy factory farms. **The deadline for comments on October 23rd at 4:00 PM is quickly approaching, so we need to put pressure on the DEQ to approve it!** [_**We’ve made it quick and easy for you with pre-written email language that you can send to the DEQ using this link.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53068948/374284777/1120709316?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjUxZTc3NWUzLTczNTEtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ms5s5L10vht0C5WB9vDTVaCjsNo6gO2XkCQyb3EBcKw=&emci=59f56a9d-d250-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=51e775e3-7351-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=2107230) If this pollution continues to go unregulated, the health of our communities and our environment will suffer. The state should stop putting our air quality, climate, and rural communities at risk by failing to regulate air pollution from Oregon dairy producers. We need everybody to make their voices heard and let the DEQ know that we won’t stand for harm to our communities at the hands of Big Ag. With the deadline so close, we know that this is an urgent and last-minute ask, so **[please submit a public comment asking regulators to protect our air from dirty factory farm pollution before time runs out at 4:00 PM on Sunday!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53068949/374284778/1120709316?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjUxZTc3NWUzLTczNTEtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ms5s5L10vht0C5WB9vDTVaCjsNo6gO2XkCQyb3EBcKw=&emci=59f56a9d-d250-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=51e775e3-7351-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=2107230)** Thank you,

Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV |

body:
I’m on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zbfpahhbd4nfk0s73r2ak807dmbosjktoqn2anqo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65shlc5gb3cllckp34o77curbcd9j6lhbaob4spgnctbjelgjcc70e1pnap3i6qrrfkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj32c5lmoo74s36epgb6p1nm2qmash1k8gn48n24hhm6or6ctge1oj5c8iv0)
[](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z2v8iqdgqqetb9e8bjg8nen737ckt2fv4rpoaec8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)

Friend,

Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing "White Lives Matter" shirts.

[](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zfn744eg88kk2oc6hmdegcvaf2rlboaotavv1f68_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)

"Why?" you may ask.

As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us.

Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities.

I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[_**Can I count on you to support your fellow Americans and the BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $10, $50, $100, $500, $1,000 or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zomk44uk37pu97gpieb3dutbnvp6qqjjgdpq0qr0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)

Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities:

**No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total.

Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it.

No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders.

No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test.**

The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities.

In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above?

[_**Please consider supporting BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $10, $25, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zcfqtqn92v76evht41almmj50a3jf3crggmchnjg_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zijqiri7igp24lav2jet52uvcnijrauvq805082o_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)

[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zkrhs9jhn3l3s4ob34fjce1vsr08drg3q0s48org_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zl0g7rr1hcb2076a398e9j8hu1mgjiuassemefuo_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zanmjrp0s030rkp6qnma36d87d8idigs57rustug_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z30sq36u9a3i4revil02la3vkqfr4dsgam2j2pp0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z6a3kemg09nfeo8ttvems60mlp29tdd0mntdqdng_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)
