Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this.

_**" One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity."**_

This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today.

It's the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities.

_We 're told we're victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. _

This is simply not true.

BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. **Our message is about UNITING people -_that means all people_ \- not division. **

[_**Your support empowers, awakens, and inspires millions of minorities to pursue the American dream and shape their own futures. Please send your generous gift today and help them find their BLEXIT >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z9ftlp57r05fie35381ucb4t1ef9fm0hi9m228t8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)

**Here 's how BLEXIT Foundation is helping.**

Friend, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That's why I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters.

**BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events.**

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice** : Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zpih2hmeviaqaoee0hd1iaj6f7m1q5m39siq8ai8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)

* **Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform** : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zlfm64ibkf3bbujg4kgv7hgf4gbiueu20p9h50c8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship** : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zn0ade8fdr27hju0hflg5pa37vet7u59q1v8pjhg_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zm6t0ls1m1qt5i10f0s8q3ajuv1ntft0gd31adsg_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message.

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

**Friend, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate.**

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z63hpj23l1ob6dvnmpu4i7bdg2tkhesnt7a16ph0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpjm1o72clh2bs)

Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities: No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total. Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it. No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders. No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test. The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities. In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above? Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this. " One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity." This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today. It's the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities. We 're told we're victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is simply not true. BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. Our message is about UNITING people -that means all people \- not division. Here 's how BLEXIT Foundation is helping. Friend, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That's why I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters. BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice : Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Entrepreneurship : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. Friend, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate. Thank you, Candace Owens Co-Founder & President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. All contributions are tax-deductible to the extent provided by law. Hi friend, Mandela Barnes here.
If you've been waiting for the best time to make your impact felt in Wisconsin, there has never been a better time than right now. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-barnes?refcode=221021]
I just wrapped up my final debate against Ron Johnson, and here is what you need to know:
Our campaign is about protecting every woman's right to receive an abortion, while Ron Johnson has co-sponsored eight national abortion bans.
Our campaign is about leveling the playing field for working people and rebuilding the middle class, while Ron Johnson is an out-of-touch millionaire who used his time in office to benefit himself.
Our campaign is about ending corporate greed, while Ron Johnson relies on corporate PAC money to fund his campaign.

Our campaign is about building a grassroots movement to flip Wisconsin's Senate seat, while Ron Johnson relies on his billionaire-funded super PACs to win.
That means I am counting on you, friends. I simply could not do this without the support of people like you.
Ron Johnson and Republican dark-money groups have spent $31 million on attack ads against me in Wisconsin. They're outspending us by 2 to 1 some weeks, and we can't risk losing any more ground in this race.
So please, I am humbly asking:
Can I count on you to use this link to split a contribution of $25 between my campaign and Seth Moulton, or whatever you can afford, to defeat Ron Johnson and flip Wisconsin's Senate seat? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-barnes?refcode=221021]
Thank you in advance for adding your contribution before midnight. It's what we do together during big moments like this one that will make all the difference in this race.
Mandela

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: This fills me with optimism
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
I don't know that there's a more important moment, in a more important
place than what's happening in Texas today.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221021-1.Le1-9v&refcode=ema20221021-213634&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=213634%2E444211%2EzX_RVx ]Please chip in now. It’ll help make sure that we have the resources to
reach the voters who are going to decide the outcome of the most important
governor's race in America.

It was 19 months ago when the power grid — which Greg Abbott had been
warned about — absolutely failed us. The lights went out, the heat stopped
running, and the water stopped flowing because it was frozen in the pipes
for millions of Texans. More than 700 people died — of hypothermia, carbon
monoxide poisoning in their garages, and burning up in their homes as they
set fire to their furniture trying to keep their kids warm.

During this crisis, Abbott pegged the price of electricity at its highest
allowable rate for days and gas soon started trading at 200 times what it
had sold for before. Abbott's biggest campaign contributors ended up
making billions of dollars over the course of those five days. The kicker
is that after all that happened, the grid is still not fixed, and we are
all paying higher electricity and utility bills as a result.

This governor failed the most basic job of government, to keep the lights
on in the energy capital of the world. Add to that that we now lead the
nation in the number of school shootings, and that gun violence is now the
leading cause of death for kids and teenagers in the state of Texas.

This Tuesday marks 22 weeks since 19 kids and their two amazing teachers
were killed in their classrooms by an 18-year-old who could legally buy
not one but two AR-15s and hundreds of rounds of ammunition. Five of the
worst mass shootings in U.S. history have happened in the last five years,
and the only thing that Abbott has done is make it easier for people who
shouldn't have a weapon to buy a gun and carry them openly on our streets.

What may be most galvanizing for millions in this state is the extreme
abortion ban that Abbott signed into law that just went into effect in
August. It begins at conception with no exception for rape or incest. This
is happening in a state that leads the country in this crisis of maternal
mortality that is three times as deadly for Black women. We absolutely
know this is going to cause more suffering and death in the state of
Texas.

The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. But the
way that Texans are responding is incredibly inspiring and fills me with
optimism and a lot of confidence that we're going to win this fight on
November 8th.

People are not accepting this, they're not submitting to it, and they're
not succumbing to the temptation to despair. They're taking action and
they're showing up.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221021-1.Le1-9v&refcode=ema20221021-213634&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=213634%2E444211%2EzX_RVx ]Will you join our growing effort to win this election, overcome these
challenges, and get Texas on the right track by making a $3
donation today? I need you with us.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221021-1.Le1-9v&refcode=ema20221021-213634&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=213634%2E444211%2EzX_RVx ]Contribute $3

Thank you,

Beto

Folks, this is John Kennedy.
My friend President Donald J. Trump and I are cut from the same cloth in a lot of ways. We both can smell BS from a mile away and we don't trust the Liberal Media further than we can throw them.
_We 're all busy people -- you too, Friend -- we don't have time to mess around!_
So let me level with you: I just got off the phone with some old Conservative buddies of mine in the House. They told me they're about to miss the FINAL deadline before the election...
**We 'd have a real mess on our hands if they can't make up some ground before then. It could cost us the entire election if I'm being honest. **
[**With respect, I 'm writing to you in the last few hours to humbly ask for a couple bucks before time officially runs out. Do you think you could find it in your heart to do that for me? **](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zksci0uitu2o64e2d7o9nqtq7ucifdb4todpa2f0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpge0or2chh2bs)
The last major deadline of an election is always important but now I'm hearing Republicans are behind by 8 million bucks, Pelosi is using her fundraising lead to HAMMER battleground states with Fake News and anti-Trump propaganda, and now we're behind the polls.
**I 'm worried missing this last deadline could lose us the House AND Senate. That's not something I'm willing to gamble, so we really need your help right now.**

[**Can we count on your badly-needed support? I hope so because I 'm afraid we're completely out of options. **](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg97cfs43aob6clkpt278gegonf59veregeg8si0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cpge0or2chh2bs)

clean_body: Peter, you would get it... | | | Hi Peter – I'm on the road, in between campaign stops, so I just have a few minutes to catch you. This couldn't wait, and I know you would understand why. I've driven hundreds of thousands of miles across the country this year. Sometimes, it was to visit family or friends, but those many miles were mostly on the way to help a Democratic campaign. It's something I'm very familiar with, having led my first political race as a teenager. Now, I lead United Rural Democrats. Our mission is to help bolster the Democratic base in rural communities and organize a movement that can win back districts that we know can flip blue. I know you would understand why this mission is important because you've been a long-time supporter of our work and Democrats across the country. We're coming up on Election Day, and I know that dozens of Democrats still need our support. We can't leave them behind, and we can't let the GOP take over our government with their right-wing agenda and dangerous threats to democracy. That's why I want to ask you, Peter, if you can chip in $10, or as much as you are able, to support our mission of electing Democratic candidates in November. | Hello Peter,While it's sure fun to poke fun at California, the risk of Idaho turning into the next California is very real. Just ask Oregon and Washington. The power of the liberal left to abscond with a state's true identity is as great as it is insidious. To make it worse, many in the Idaho government are doing nothing to stop our slide down the leftest path. You know what I'm talking about, you have seen it; more crime, more drugs, more homelessness - especially in Boise. It is like our governor and his advisors want them to come to Idaho. Did you know that in the last few years Idaho has increased its food stamps program _more than any other state in the country_. Yep, 24.2% - the highest of all the states. Welfare programs are also at an all-time high in Idaho, consuming 39.7% of the state's annual budget. Idaho might as well be giving the liberals a personal invitation to come and live here and you and I know what they will do when they take over. Please check out my latest video on this topic...

Yours Sincerely,Ammon Bundy

Dear Peter,

Catherine Cortez Masto (D) in the race that will decide Senate control. If Trump tips the scales in favor of his hand-picked extremist, Adam Laxalt (R)– if they defeat Sen. Cortez Masto – then Democrats will lose the Senate and Mitch McConnell will regain his iron grip on power. I refuse to sit on the sidelines and watch our country return to dark days where truth is thwarted by lies and conspiracies and where the selfish interests of deranged extremists reign supreme. That's why I need you to join me in fighting back against Trump and helping Sen. Cortez Masto protect this seat and our majority. **[I’m personally asking you: Will you split $25 between Catherine’s campaign and BlueAmp Action to combat Trump's attacks, keep Nevada blue and defend our Senate majority?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Teef1dbef-cf61-4621-bb9a-c8f05e511092/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

| I've been an activist my entire life, Peter. I've witnessed moments where people came together by the thousands, by the millions, to usher in great progress for this nation. But I've also seen the consequences when not enough people rise to the urgency of the moment before them – and right now I can say to you with confidence that we've never faced a more urgent, a more important, midterm election. If Republicans flip the one seat they need to retake control – if they flip this seat – they will usher in an era of zero bodily autonomy for women, of further attacks on voting and free and fair elections, of turning a blind eye to climate change. They will roll out the red carpet for the return of the impeached former president. It's why Donald Trump himself flew all the way to Nevada to hold one of his infamous, dangerous MAGA rallies: to defeat Catherine Cortez Masto and begin his return to power. We must do everything we can to stop him, and that means ensuring Catherine has the resources to fight back and win. **[Please, rush $25 or whatever you can spare to fight back against Trump, help Catherine Cortez Masto win in Nevada and protect our Democratic Senate majority.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T61caa42e-34d0-4bce-a221-5e5a7d2995b8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) ** Thank you, Martin Sheen

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cc39b339f33f488cb5b3c82d8cc82ec1&_e=TIVtFLjH5-AJrDBS7ZJCKBPjUYMwWFYxDvUgwIHXSvP0soH8uBy4bxhZFPXlX4a7bM2sPXGrHTiXg8d0jTBCo_gXDvIxlg8yC-vuqvNjMua5Oq1pJJJNS_SDSE0a1odlSQV71qa0EmHkMs-n4tF6h-Zk2ZO2Y7IcjsDaA2UKFyC1PbvMEbZ7kfY7G8EkWiGFen_cWNUSknbYB1rndm7U65qyPLgpoz92e9i8-6GlciJQ4_QKuKIXkxvO8ap0YP04MQ-s50I1rlXPmHrurWJVr5mgReJHZW8eJp-U-z4G4vXTUwKRTbIoUwG3ZCqTDcR39ceuQJx32AEYQRavie_HY10PCsWfjrgyGqqWjOzX8e0-LaS2aNnbrVmkoe1KPFyo1Tl0-GN8fmRQvZ8WuuPZpw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cc39b339f33f488cb5b3c82d8cc82ec1&_e=TIVtFLjH5-AJrDBS7ZJCKBPjUYMwWFYxDvUgwIHXSvP0soH8uBy4bxhZFPXlX4a7bM2sPXGrHTiXg8d0jTBCo_gXDvIxlg8yC-vuqvNjMua5Oq1pJJJNS_SDSE0a1odlSQV71qa0EmHkMs-n4tF6h-Zk2ZO2Y7IcjsDaA2UKFyC1PbvMEbZ7kfY7G8EkWiGFen_cWNUSknbYB1rndm7U65qyPLgpoz92e9i8-6GlciLmXS4ln0yFC-Ok5Bk8rUhjFTWI66p2xRVPDwxfd6eIT5lj736R0hKBZLFH_iynu_N3FD8IBjOb1CH0pPL8htdudCViMBSLQJ8ZL6e2IKRJCzECBL6pTNLQ-C5D7aopphv-_d-YMqlxFCz5LBg47L44l8Q5Qj8ibETvfui04eoC3g%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cc39b339f33f488cb5b3c82d8cc82ec1&_e=TIVtFLjH5-AJrDBS7ZJCKBPjUYMwWFYxDvUgwIHXSvP0soH8uBy4bxhZFPXlX4a7bM2sPXGrHTiXg8d0jTBCo_gXDvIxlg8yC-vuqvNjMua5Oq1pJJJNS_SDSE0a1odlSQV71qa0EmHkMs-n4tF6h-Zk2ZO2Y7IcjsDaA2UKFyC1PbvMEbZ7kfY7G8EkWiGFen_cWNUSknbYB1rndm7U65qyPLgpoz92e9i8-6GlciL5pyOs8IoxO5tlV9PvsaWkc-TOE6XCFxqJXshZWFW0eeVWbIsIMQzkQmPYJEUh7grhXKRXblpUdgR0tuPLJR9y5mzieJ3xs1V3c_B8G7ZZzbpwccXFflH8Kd7d4WkSsC0LddHlg-ZV1g5NxVrkzocfzY3qHAZzJFOnPSLfcAqA_g%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

---
| | **October 21, 2022**
---
| | **Attorney General Jason Miyares Responds to Delegate Greenhalgh's Letter on Religious Freedom**
---
| |
---
| | At the beginning of the July, Delegate Greenhalgh hand delivered a letter to the office of Attorney General Jason Miyares requesting a legal opinion on the following questions:
1. Can a test or standard be placed to evaluate or judge the religious beliefs held by an individual?
2. Does any person, organization, business, civil government, or any entity ever have the right to deny or override an individual's religious belief?

On September 30th, the Attorney General provided a formal response to the questions raised in Delegate Greenhalgh's letter. To view the full text of Delegate Greenhalgh's letter and the Attorney General's response, [click here](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/1726f654e8295641/d31fe8ae401b597cc3d6b838967d376c/37923).
---
|
---
| | **Delegate Greenhalgh Attends Small Business Commission Meeting**
---
The Small Business Commission met at the state Capitol for the first time this year. During the meeting, Delegate Greenhalgh and her colleagues discussed the numerous challenges small businesses are facing across Virginia. Of the many issues examined, the current labor shortage stands out as the most pressing problem impacting small businesses. In order to address this issue the Commission is analyzing the contributing factors impacting the workforces ability, willingness, and readiness to work. **If you are a small business owner, Delegate Greenhalgh wants to hear from you!** To help her with her work on the Small Business Commission, the Delegate is asking small business owners in her district to respond to these three questions:
1. What is the most challenging problem facing your business?
2. Many people have not reentered the workforce since Covid restrictions lifted. In your experience with employees, do you have an opinion on why we have this problem?
3. How should we define a Small Business? By number of employees, by gross income, or a combination of both? How many employees and what gross income would you suggest?

We would love to hear your input! Please reply to this message with your responses to these questions, or email [DelKGreenhalgh@house.virginia.gov](mailto:DelKGreenhalgh@house.virginia.gov).
---
| | |
---
**Chesapeake Bay Foundation's Lynnhaven Boat Trip**
---
| |
---
| | Delegate Greenhalgh and her grandson attended the Chesapeake Bay Foundation's Decision Makers Boat Trip on the Lynnhaven River last week. The trip included a demonstration of water quality testing, fish sampling, and a thoughtful discussion on pollution prevention and habitat protection. Delegate Greenhalgh recognizes how precious Virginia Beach's natural resources are for the enjoyment of our residents and to the local economy. She is always happy to have opportunities like this to learn more!
---
| | |
---

I was a student-athlete (volleyball & basketball), scholar, and class president of my high school. I worked hard and played hard. Christian Conservative (Father - Navy SEAL - Business Owner) | Dear Friend, Please vote! early The General Election is November 8, just 18 days away. We are living in dangerous times. I am concerned for our Republic and I am concerned for the human race. Democrat train-wreck policies are destroying America. Democrat politicians who shut down your businesses and killed countless careers are now asking that you reelect them so they can keep their jobs. Never forget mayors sent swat teams to shut down churches and barbershops but let looters and antifa burn down our cities. Please ask friends to vote early for our Virginia Republican Candidates for Congress: 1st Rob Wittman 2nd Jen Kiggens 3rd Terry Namkung 4th Leon Benjamin 5th Bob Good 6th Ben Cline 7th Yesli Vega 8th Karina Lipsman 9th H. Morgan Griffith 10th Hung Cao 11th James Myles Inflation, open borders, fentanyl, life, our Second Amendment, farmers, and more are on the ballot this November. Much more important than me, at this point in time, is getting Bob Good, Yesli Vega, Rob Wittman, and the rest of our congressional delegation elected this November. Yes, I am running for State Senate, but we can worry about that more after November 8. Please pray, vote, volunteer, and help spread the word so that we can win back Congress and stop the Biden White House. I'm working on legislation for 2023. Please email your ideas to: mailto:john@mcguireforvirginia.com Here are a few upcoming events and some of the things on my mind, and what I've been up to around the district: | Governor Youngkin 55% Approval! | | Congratulations Governor Youngkin on a 55% approval rating! How many of you are glad to have a republican governor in Virginia! == == == | Day 1 Bone Frog Open | | In Goochland County, Navy SEAL Lieutenant Jason C. Redman who served with me at SEAL Team Four, read the names out loud of every SEAL killed since 9/11. Freedom isn't free, it struck me how many of those killed were friends of mine. In this photo, my brothers and I are praying for our fallen and their families. | | | | | | | | | | The == is held each year in Goochland County, was established in 2019 to honor fallen U.S. Navy SEALs. The event is about awareness, remembrance, patriotism, camaraderie, and fun. The goal is to celebrate legacies and raise money to support military, first responders, and their families as a way of doing our part to thank these men and women for being the ones to run toward danger, not away from it. | Day 2 Bone Frog Open | | | This year we raised $500,000 and I got a chance to spend time with many friends including many of my fellow SEAL brothers. | Powhatan GOP | | | I had a wonderful time at the Powhatan GOP Committee meeting. It was good to see my colleague and friend Delegate Lee Ware, National Committee Woman Patti Lyman, and Vickie Hurt for School Board. Thank you Chair Steve Jenkins and committee for working so hard to ensure Republicans win 8 November! | | End COVID 19 Mandates | | I agree with Governor Youngkin. In July I submitted a bill draft to legislative services to eliminate the requirement for Covid vaccines for students, teachers, and employees in Virginia. What do you think? | Keith and Kristyn Getty Concert | | We attended the Keith & Kristyn Getty Concert, a Northern Irish Christian duo, right here in District 56. Due to the success of "In Christ Alone", the duo has spearheaded the modern hymn genre. Other popular hymns include "The Power of the Cross", "The Lord Is My Salvation", "By Faith", and "Speak O Lord". Learn more ==. | Middle Resolution VEOA | | I attended the Virginia Education Opportunity Alliance hosted by the Middle Resolution in Hanover County. clean_body: Here’s how I’m working to win back Trump’s Majority... | Peter, Early voting is here in North Carolina, and in Battleground States across the nation. That’s why I’m shifting my focus to campaigning full-time to and make sure that every eligible Republican voter makes it to the polls on (or before) Election Day. Yesterday, I was campaigning with Trump-Endorsed Republican Bo Hines in North Carolina’s 13th District, which is an must-win battleground if we’re going to restore Trump’s Majority in Congress. But I’ve got to be honest, Peter... it’s closer than I’d like it to be out there, and we’re going to need to work every single day until the last vote is counted to secure victory and save America. | Official 2022 Election Fund EMAIL: SUPPORTER ID: #05966106 DEADLINE: 11:59 PM TONIGHT SUGGESTED GIFT: $10 or more | | | | | | | We’re so close to the finish line, Peter, and we can’t afford to falter now. body:
| The Washington Post just reported that House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy is prepared to cut Medicare and Social Security if Republicans win the majority.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=1144%2E5257348%2EVrtJzg)
Let’s make this plain, Derek. Social Security and Medicare are on the GOP’s chopping block.
**The _Washington Post_ just reported that House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy is prepared to cut Medicare and Social Security if Republicans win the majority. He is even threatening to hold the US economy hostage and default on our national debt by refusing to raise the debt ceiling in order to get the cuts he wants to these critical programs.**
Such a default alone would trigger a global economic meltdown and could very well start another depression.
All so that Republicans can cut Medicare and the Social Security checks that Americans have earned. Just to provide a return on investment to the GOP’s billionaire campaign donors. They simply don’t care if it means that seniors will struggle even more to get by.
Republicans _only_ threaten to default on our debt when there is a Democratic president. Congress raised the debt ceiling three times during the Trump administration.
Republicans passed a tax scam in the dead of night with corporate lobbyists literally writing the amendments. Lindsey Graham told a reporter _“the financial contributions would stop”_ if they didn’t pass it.
The national debt climbed to **_$7 trillion_**.
Republicans love to play politics when it suits them, but the fact of the matter is that their economic plans have brought nothing but catastrophe.
We can’t let Kevin McCarthy lay a finger on our Medicare and Social Security — these programs must be protected. We can’t let McCarthy become Speaker.
**[Please, Derek, chip in $10 or whatever you can spare today to fight back against McCarthy’s threat to default on the nation’s debt, to protect our House majority, and to protect Medicare and Social Security.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=oct2022_abs_em.GZkB9F&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20221021_PM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=4&akid=1144%2E5257348%2EVrtJzg)**

Monday is the official start of early voting in South Carolina and Wednesday is the one and only debate in this race.

We need to be ready for what’s going to be the biggest week of this campaign.

name: Conservative Liberty Wire
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c967dfbb04dd42b58f631883f1b4c933&_e=9YBxmmOPQIHA2AKvfWCxVtw00azLtdDiYajbYp8fG1Z78_W_tdPPmI3VufgdEqkzScPN_sSIZFDo1TcGRmdedUp0yr2gZ6R5XAIjXlsYGs-Vw2Y7_I356JF1p7KvkCASuL6W6wKbVYk7FaBmh8qCTJLT6lk1-BrC79iL4mwjGtl5vIIc_Kr116mk3HKdlVf8VjWyAGUC7BGX1xh4Ud2EoJQbWrF-AJKyIVds_-c4pDqZD-ET2FSQhYvVDb9444DdOBJMsAxUPHA6CLciNid5SXQE11zXkYVA7c_nMZDsNuQWN8iDYzaYXKOd6HWdgaDNvc00UnZiaOU5L6sXgvZOnrbKYvkDasBi7U0tFnP_llx_0ILp0GXeo6a8j08TyiH11BXmZuvtteMkgDUNr_4D2g%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.
A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.**
By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.
You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below:
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c967dfbb04dd42b58f631883f1b4c933&_e=9YBxmmOPQIHA2AKvfWCxVtw00azLtdDiYajbYp8fG1Z78_W_tdPPmI3VufgdEqkzScPN_sSIZFDo1TcGRmdedUp0yr2gZ6R5XAIjXlsYGs-Vw2Y7_I356JF1p7KvkCASuL6W6wKbVYk7FaBmh8qCTJLT6lk1-BrC79iL4mwjGtl5vIIc_Kr116mk3HKdlVf8VjWyAGUC7BGX1xh4Ud2EoJQbWrF-AJKyIVds_-c4pDqynX_peY97qqc7d1O6M7P1v-EH05jYRA89-lxrpZieEzQnriHQQLcn8M7p5ejCadstuwDUQ_eBdkxoX8ClgN5fkYHyYDOT2H0VR_BCijAUyyeCOIqmVGUWsxUp8F1vU2ahO-TiRCOQDRT7B6f9iHGbAFtKMwK6roBif_VXoZIoXg%3D%3D)**
For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.
**But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.**
This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.
Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states.
These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College.
**And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.**
So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.
**You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:**
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c967dfbb04dd42b58f631883f1b4c933&_e=9YBxmmOPQIHA2AKvfWCxVtw00azLtdDiYajbYp8fG1Z78_W_tdPPmI3VufgdEqkzScPN_sSIZFDo1TcGRmdedUp0yr2gZ6R5XAIjXlsYGs-Vw2Y7_I356JF1p7KvkCASuL6W6wKbVYk7FaBmh8qCTJLT6lk1-BrC79iL4mwjGtl5vIIc_Kr116mk3HKdlVf8VjWyAGUC7BGX1xh4Ud2EoJQbWrF-AJKyIVds_-c4pDroQkS1R5xGR9TsRe2doaGj9PaffYaOmzdE8-qCHt945wW8v9DmTJOadI5XNfa-O_LV-FGFMRSaeNtXZ2KBcgPYOrGJPSMIgN6BvkFuLWnW3qKlQ7yQg2x476aeepcul6h4Ia-1U9hreNn_Pfm-GNqCxGsdb0db_0ueSWun9CKXjQ%3D%3D)**
And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.
Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.
Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

subject: This would mean the world to me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SCOTT FOR SENATE
body:
|
---
| | | Friend, it's Tim Scott. I only have a minute so I'm going to get straight to the point.

I grew up in a single-parent household and almost failed out of high school. If it weren't for my supportive mother and mentors, who knows where I would be today.

The American Dream - the possibility of going from cotton to Congress - was never guaranteed to me. Now, I'm committed to making sure that every child has the same opportunities regardless of which side of the tracks they grew up on.

But listen, Friend, winning this fight is impossible without your support.

| Peter,

This month and last, we have been traveling around the state for our Build a Better Maryland Tour – a series of roundtable discussions with Marylanders in different fields. Here’s a quick update on our Tour:
* **We had 11 Roundtable Policy Discussions in less than one month!**
* We’ve met with union leaders, women business owners, municipal leaders, Maryland manufacturers, tax professionals, farmers and agriculturists, and so many more!
* We’ve had critical conversations about diverse and varied topics like building climate-resilient communities, financial literacy, and rural economic development.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53060434/374272225/-1465349915?refcode=BLU-BLMD-20221021-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDYwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OTQ5MmFkZS02YTUxLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dwbRZ3eSDtm0vomexNMQ95DhqSzonhf_M1_cISv840M=) We’ve had so much fun on this tour, discussing people’s areas of expertise and how they want to see the state support people from all corners.

These roundtables allow Brooke to hear directly from Marylanders about the opportunities and challenges for their colleagues and community. Brooke also shares her vision for ensuring the Comptroller's office provides Maryland’s families and small businesses the resources they need to thrive.

**Together, we can reimagine what the Comptroller’s office can do to support families, strengthen public schools, empower small businesses, and build a better Maryland for all. These roundtables are just one more way that Brooke is showing up for Maryland – and running a truly 24-county campaign!**

Thank you for all you do.

Team Lierman

Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)

body:
Hi,
In a minute, I’ll ask you to split a critical donation between CommonGood and my campaign to flip Ohio’s open Senate seat blue. But first, let me explain why this race — and your donation — are so important today.
Protecting our Democratic Senate majority is not enough. If we want to stop Mitch McConnell from abusing the filibuster, we must expand our Senate majority. And flipping Ohio’s open Senate seat is our best chance to do just that.
A new poll shows this race in a dead heat against JD Vance. Now all we need is you.
Whether or not we can flip this seat depends on you. We need the resources right now to build the team it’ll take to win. Will you split a donation of $25 or more to help us flip Ohio blue and expand the Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_tr?refcode=20221021_CGVA_Ryan]
Donald Trump has made this race his top target. That’s why he attacked me during his rallies, saying Republicans “can’t take a chance” when it comes to running against me. It’s clear we’ve got the GOP running scared.
My GOP opponent, JD Vance, is a multi-millionaire. Billionaire tech giant Peter Thiel has propped up JD Vance with a $10 million super PAC. He’s completely out-of-touch with hardworking Ohioans.
Me? I’ve been on picket lines and in union halls my whole life. I’m still paying off my family’s student loans and mortgage. I’m fighting like hell to cut workers in on the deal — not prop up my wealthy friends and right-wing special interests.
I believe we can win this race. CNN ranks us as one of the most likely seats to flip. But this is on track to be one of the most competitive and expensive races. So, I’m turning to you:
We’ll need a surge of grassroots support to take on the GOP and come out on top. Please, split a donation today to help us win this critical race. Anything you can chip in makes a difference.

Fellow Conservative,

**They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting.** The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because **they're somehow _still_ not sure that I'm worth the investment. **

Instead of putting money into my race, **they're spending millions on seats we can't win.** But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; **here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.**

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the month (October 31st), and they'll make an investment in my race; if i can't, I'll be on my own till the end.**

With only days to go, we’re still short about $8,000. **[If you’re in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=31d71aea059a4f45b371542de3b58eca&_e=KOw2AV00Z-HXqbsLPUjHUDJyZrlrAN1dRQAQabSdqJSvIfoWZGQNeBCbTCAmJsIQL9bwaogwHYO9aAgsT5kACF-A5QwHyO5uHzqm-dQwAG_2nU4jSXTblUfl4e6osbxbbg4BDgZYVvX2_iGNMAf0ixCtGmWAsoBTIrU1S1F06TixUm25hVVVW9tLjdjoE73JjM5JcNJki0wo7Rxmtc7t6hsx-tVFAZ2DBx97XfbL6NVqvAMl--W7smol-zT6JtMiPMOz0xHBS1VfSDyMI5TwSamv34YAsmvQSv8I2HzL5Yk5rryXLfLu-JLgYLYA9p6xMuFFL05MuYsCUilpMBd_ATO8_FsPQ42hbfDwG0Lqe7BX4g9IqzQaST4IJ_7hE6pqDPY7F1cGtf_OPrmllcDPPgYU-QP1njHFUuEtIW8QGLw%3D)**

| [**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=31d71aea059a4f45b371542de3b58eca&_e=KOw2AV00Z-HXqbsLPUjHUDJyZrlrAN1dRQAQabSdqJSvIfoWZGQNeBCbTCAmJsIQL9bwaogwHYO9aAgsT5kACF-A5QwHyO5uHzqm-dQwAG_2nU4jSXTblUfl4e6osbxbbg4BDgZYVvX2_iGNMAf0ixCtGmWAsoBTIrU1S1F06TixUm25hVVVW9tLjdjoE73JjM5JcNJki0wo7Rxmtc7t6hsx-tVFAZ2DBx97XfbL6NVqvAMl--W7smol-zT6JtMiPMOz0xHBS1VfSDyMI5TwSWNX_0eukQDMBw35OTJKtZzPNRFP6IvA1aT2WBbSNZgIeRPXHUfh1i0jQBoIFBGFe4Mu98ufi2B7C-gAOuhMBaL7DlCVIR4oNRk12nmhtfP15On06zHDLhsit_KTmHIRSrrSbYGQafn8pjvpjXsR_b8%3D)

**[If you’re on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=31d71aea059a4f45b371542de3b58eca&_e=KOw2AV00Z-HXqbsLPUjHUDJyZrlrAN1dRQAQabSdqJSvIfoWZGQNeBCbTCAmJsIQL9bwaogwHYO9aAgsT5kACF-A5QwHyO5uHzqm-dQwAG_2nU4jSXTblUfl4e6osbxbbg4BDgZYVvX2_iGNMAf0ixCtGmWAsoBTIrU1S1F06TixUm25hVVVW9tLjdjoE73JjM5JcNJki0wo7Rxmtc7t6hsx-tVFAZ2DBx97XfbL6NVqvAMl--W7smol-zT6JtMiPMOz0xHBS1VfSDyMI5TwSS0ByUDPlzPvllO2zOhswzOv53IiZ8r4pE7arzhMW4biix68EtHpkjFtILHpEIq1NzNxXH5mWPD8fIFuq_SjeWXSP1CjOMT9anGCakkbBuWbZpG3mpb0HAiBLY05Sq4pojK6HfMyNMVFVCV5BPCYhzo%3D)**

My opponent this year is a the protegée of my opponent from 2020, meaning she supports the Green New Deal, and would most certainly join the House Progressive Caucus.

Republicans came within 554 votes in 2016 from flipping OR-4 from BLUE to RED. Please help me finish the job this time around. If I'm able to secure a sizeable investment from Republicans in D.C., I know we can overcome the barriers that kept us from winning this race two years ago.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=31d71aea059a4f45b371542de3b58eca&_e=KOw2AV00Z-HXqbsLPUjHUDJyZrlrAN1dRQAQabSdqJSvIfoWZGQNeBCbTCAmJsIQL9bwaogwHYO9aAgsT5kACF-A5QwHyO5uHzqm-dQwAG_2nU4jSXTblUfl4e6osbxbbg4BDgZYVvX2_iGNMAf0ixCtGmWAsoBTIrU1S1F06TixUm25hVVVW9tLjdjoE73JjM5JcNJki0wo7Rxmtc7t6hsx-tVFAZ2DBx97XfbL6NVqvAMl--W7smol-zT6JtMiPMOz0xHBS1VfSDyMI5TwSSyoS26B1TphYW2qaaOmGhylQDmV7bka69iEIjp7VGSPrRkK8Q9z0n5KosdV_HuFcm8CmpXuexpK54ZacgIqFaGu665hJ18QT5iVQHMVpsGMQ33NxcG4HjMSmrM-v9RfxeJNFwK3tPNc_MXEMhBOxPQ%3D)
---

I know that you have a lot of political candidates asking for you to make contributions to their campaign, but I’d like you to ask yourself this: how many races could realistically determine whether or not Nancy Pelosi loses the speaker’s gavel next Congress? **Less than 10**.

Thanks for your consideration, Fellow Conservative

body:
Folks, this is John Kennedy.
My friend President Donald J. Trump and I are cut from the same cloth in a lot of ways. We both can smell BS from a mile away and we don’t trust the Liberal Media further than we can throw them.
_We’re all busy people -- you too, %%First Name%% -- we don’t have time to mess around!_
So let me level with you: I just got off the phone with some old Conservative buddies of mine in the House. They told me they’re about to miss the FINAL deadline before the election...
**We’d have a real mess on our hands if they can’t make up some ground before then. It could cost us the entire election if I’m being honest.**
[**With respect, I’m writing to you in the last few hours to humbly ask for a couple bucks before time officially runs out. Do you think you could find it in your heart to do that for me?**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=d422eba3255d4ef4a054afb46de99048&_e=nLeFhEiDWgzQwbgZIRLMYcHXRUN4fNj513724BeRxWgYDNZWZ9Do8vvGzsIP-PfH91H92Y4bQoMAyUvflUQgbGiCoPBXBKRK0kqO7l3kFYMlG2fkkF48O1KgSWTATtxiw42zJ9AwRKwARzUvq64GQkO7EA0L4lSrKMZIcAGAqUEq1t6BJdSd0kzhmpOkF92iroBtB5PpUKNuG1fxOBiFsczU4BVVf_50F55FHVljb7whoarDshRcumKUrmusnwT8GAwNJ8UQmJkWvOmPmVGLuRKzoq4s4D40WJmO4stHliJq8QjDkoxiSBU3RidZcIm2vTBVX7OuONcHn5OAndBggsYGW0bysUf74jlYCnDOpCO5R3v-RbO_M3Hyz3jNfNTfUFd8nRM5i6iJvbfIiio7-sKEG3Hz9zuZ87rJK-rwlU4%3D)

subject: Warnock supporters are calling me racial slurs
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
|
---

Peter,

I knew when I decided to run for office that my campaign would be met with support from a whole lot of folks, and I've been honored to see that support at hundreds of campaign stops across Georgia.

**But there are also racist bigots who want to demean me for the color of my skin and tear me apart because of my conservative viewpoints.**

I was attacked with racial slurs at a campaign event because I don't fit the Left's idea of what it means to be Black and conservative in America.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61704624:6GhjqRVN8:m:1:3350876382:AA26FE3DA6A4072432542B7DDBD7343C:r)
While I was holding a press conference in front of an apartment building owned by Raphael Warnock's church - which has attempted to evict residents for late rent payments **(sometimes for as little as $28)** , a protester in the crowd said of me:

| _**" He's a joke. He tap dances, and he's a house n*****."**_
---

The reporters who were covering our event said _**nothing**_.

The local reporters who were covering our event questioned **no one** , despite urgent pleas from my campaign staff to do so. Unfortunately, this doesn't surprise me because that's the mainstream media for you. If Fox News had not reported it, the protester would've gotten away with it in plain sight.

Peter, it's sad this is the type of environment we're running in, but it's a pattern from the Left we've seen numerous times throughout this campaign. With early voting already underway, **[we need to ensure Georgians that we're not fazed by the nasty attacks against us.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61704624:6GhjqRVN8:m:1:3350876382:AA26FE3DA6A4072432542B7DDBD7343C:r)**

**[Will you stand with me today to make it clear to the Left that we will not stand for this divisive, hateful language?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61704624:6GhjqRVN8:m:1:3350876382:AA26FE3DA6A4072432542B7DDBD7343C:r)**

[** Stand With Herschel -> **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61704624:6GhjqRVN8:m:1:3350876382:AA26FE3DA6A4072432542B7DDBD7343C:r)
Tuesday's protester viciously attacked me for the color of my skin because I'm willing to STAND UP for my conservative values and SPEAK OUT for the truth.

Georgia needs a new U.S. Senator, and **[I hope you'll support our campaign today to make it happen.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61704624:6GhjqRVN8:m:1:3350876382:AA26FE3DA6A4072432542B7DDBD7343C:r)**

Thank you,

Herschel Walker

There’s a lot to accomplish, but we know that together, we can get it done.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1107%2E61531%2EAsUkJf)
Team,
Peter joined this race to fight for Vermont, our country, and our imperiled democracy.
And because of you—we’ve been able to do just that. Thanks to your support, we’ve hit our fundraising targets for this final FEC deadline and are showing everyone just how strong this grassroots team is. And we’ve been doing this the **_Vermont way_ , which means listening more than talking.** Peter’s been going out and talking to Vermonters in every county, hearing what’s important to them, and turning that into action—creating policies with everyone’s interests in mind.
So right now, we would like to say how grateful we are for your support. Peter wanted to thank each of you personally, so he asked us to share this note about what this movement means to him—because **we truly could not do this without you:**
[****](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4708?t=3&akid=1107%2E61531%2EAsUkJf)
Right now, over 1000+ Vermonters from all 14 counties have endorsed Peter. Our movement has grown so much since launching this campaign, and it’s all because Peter’s record speaks for itself.
We’re ready to elect Peter to the Senate to keep fighting for a better future—to lower the cost of living, for a Green New Deal, for reproductive rights, for our democracy, and so much more.
**There’s a lot to accomplish, but we know that together, we can get it done.**
Thank you for being a part of this movement,
Peter Welch HQ

Fellow Conservative,

**They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting.** The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because **they're somehow _still_ not sure that I'm worth the investment. **

Instead of putting money into my race, **they're spending millions on seats we can't win.** But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; **here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.**

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the month (October 31st), and they'll make an investment in my race; if i can't, I'll be on my own till the end.**

body:
| Hi,

Thank you. To everyone who gave during our big FEC and debate fundraising pushes, I am so grateful.

Jayme Stevenson Statement on Biden Releasing Additional Strategic Oil Reserves
FAIRFIELD, CT - President Biden announced on Wednesday that he plans to release an additional 15 million barrels from the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve due to production cuts announced by the OPEC+ nations. Biden’s attempt to convince Saudi leaders to postpone the cuts for a month was rebuffed by OPEC leaders. The release of 180 million barrels of oil since March, brings the strategic reserves to the lowest levels since 1984. This announcement follows weeks of Democrats losing ground at the polls as rising prices and high energy costs are taking their toll on the residents of Connecticut. How much further is Biden willing to go putting our nation at risk with our global foes to buy this election for Jim Himes and other Democrats on the ballot?
In these last weeks leading up to the election, Biden’s gambit is meant to suppress rising gasoline prices at the pump and home heating oil prices as the global supply of available oil is declining. CT residents and retirees on fixed incomes are already making difficult decisions on whether to fill their oil tanks to heat their homes or buy food.
Connecticut Republican challenger for U.S. Congress Jayme Stevenson issued a statement condemning Biden’s last ditch election year gimmick.
“Under Biden’s watch, America has lost our energy independence and depleted our emergency reserves. This administration has no comprehensive energy plan nor the ability to restock diminishing reserves at a reasonable price. The U.S. is now reliant on our global foes to provide the essential resources we need to fuel our homes, cars and businesses. There is no plan to address the constraints of our existing electrical grid as U.S. citizens are forced to seek alternative energy sources. Our policy cannot be one that harms hard-working Americans and our allies in Western Europe while we pursue clean energy goals.
Energy independence is a matter of national security. Biden and Himes are playing a dangerous game with our adversaries who, in the wake of Biden’s war on the American fossil fuel industry, control global energy supply. After 14 years, Jim Himes and his party’s strategy of win-at-all-costs is deeply troubling to voters. The need for real leadership and practical solutions has never been greater.”

After 14 years, Jim Himes and his party’s strategy of win-at-all-costs is deeply troubling to voters. The need for real leadership and practical solutions has never been greater.” | | | ABOUT JAYME I’m running for Congress to bring common sense and balance back to Washington and to give voice to the people of the 4th Congressional District who have been left behind by politicians working for themselves and a national party agenda. As a trusted leader and mother of five children, I understand the impacts government policies have on our communities and promise to fight for Connecticut children, families and businesses. | "Facebook" | "Twitter" | "Instagram" ---|---|--- Jayme Stevenson 1326 Post Road, Fairfield, 06824

**\- INDEMS Launches the Contract with Women Statewide Tour -**
**** Earlier this week, INDems announced its final statewide tour for the election year: the “Contract with Women” tour.
****
Jocelyn Vare (Candidate for Indiana Senate - District 31), Victoria Garcia Wilburn (Candidate for Indiana House - District 32), Carey Hamilton (State Representative - District 87), Tom McDermott (Candidate for U.S. Senate), and Democrats sign the “Contract with Women” Democrats want to make this pledge with voters: A vote for Democrats is a vote to deliver on the most pressing-issues facing women and families across Indiana. By signing this contract, Democrats will pursue a vision that includes:
* Restoring the freedom to choose,
* Expanding the right to birth control and other contraceptives,
* Fixing Indiana’s dismal maternal mortality rate,
* Passing legitimate workplace protections for pregnant women,
* Repealing the state’s high taxes on hygiene products,
* Addressing the state’s childcare crisis, and
* Creating a statewide Pre-K system for our children.

Republican government overreach and extremism is harming the women of Indiana and the Democrats’ “Contract with Women” Tour will show Hoosier voters that our party is ready to champion women to create a brighter future for everyone. Rather than simply going along with Army protocols and the federal bureaucrats who were insisting I immediately sign paperwork to discharge my husband, I advocated for him, his dreams, and for the care I knew he had earned. When my husband finally got the care he earned, I made it my #1 mission to make sure other families don’t endure the same struggles. I’m committed to putting the U.S. government back to work for its people. And I plan to serve the American people every day when I’m elected to the Senate this November. My family and I are putting everything on the line to defeat Senator Murray and her massive political machine. But I’ll be honest. It’s going to be an uphill fight. Democrats are cringing at the idea of a more transparent and responsible government, friend. Now is our chance to defeat one of Biden’s closest supporters and smash the status quo in Washington by returning to commonsense leadership. But that all depends on your support. Thank you and God bless, Tiffany Smiley Republican Candidate for WA-SEN | | | Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad. I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick. That’s why I wrote this book. body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221021&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221021&amount=28]
Team,
With 18 days to go, I wanted to give you an update on our efforts at MSU – and let you know how you can help.
As we told you before, we have a major effort going on on MSU’s campus, with its 50,000 students. Our approach is taken from what has worked in other states like Georgia: paying young people to register their peers. So far, we’ve gotten 232 students involved in our effort and have done 1,146 hours of registering. Our goal is 6,000 voters registered on campus.
Last week was a full week on campus. I grabbed lunch with some of our organizers at the Brody cafeteria on MSU’s campus. It was a great chance for all of us to sit down away from the craziness of the campaign trail and really talk about how things are going.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221021&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221021&amount=28]
Then, it was on to the big MSU homecoming weekend. Team Slotkin joined the packed homecoming parade on Friday night and we were up bright and early the following morning for a tailgate on campus with Congressman Hakeem Jefferies (it was his first!). In true Slotkin style, our tailgate featured a hot dog cart and a voter registration booth.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221021&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221021&amount=28]
We wrapped up our week at a voter registration rally. A ton of students came out (the day after a big MSU win, no less) to hear about ways they can get involved with Team Slotkin on their campus.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87595/images/MLK%20Day%20events%20email%20graphics-9.jpg]

subject: Election Integrity
body:
Please report things to the NCGOP hotline or website below. If possible, report things immediately.

[](http://www.nc.gop/?e=04773666e8bff2ad6690a07f2e8e05fa&utm_source=ncgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ri_o_20_pm&n=1)
---
Hello --Thank you for all of the work that you have done to prepare for this election. As you know, early voting began yesterday. It will be over before we know it!As you begin to observe at the polls, I want you to be aware of the recent Wake County Superior Court ruling regarding at-large poll observers. The court granted a preliminary injunction on the State Board of Elections enforcing the four-hour restriction on at-large observers. This means the at-large observers appointed by the County Chair are permitted to come and go from the voting locations as they please. [NCGOP Press Release](https://www.nc.gop/at_large_poll_observer_win?e=04773666e8bff2ad6690a07f2e8e05fa&utm_source=ncgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ri_o_20_pm&n=2)[GOP wins legal challenge over political observers at NC polling places](https://www.nc.gop/r?u=7EL176YFyxKF3ox3wD2rUdRgsuWRyNL5mBkIi6Ha6MFurn4ZrNItIKSxM1nCgHKPKLVjSs2YwHG_dnfmZ1HqN_60foRGa5--V-64hT8LF331ffLrwhRuoB2nMd6WugJD&e=04773666e8bff2ad6690a07f2e8e05fa&utm_source=ncgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ri_o_20_pm&n=3) Next, I want to make sure that you have all of the information regarding reporting the various issues that you may encounter:**Hotline #: (919) 372-4856****Reporting Link:**[northcarolina.protectthevote.com](https://www.nc.gop/r?u=wOxw4HgWGltJOftgqJdcsepZBIKAbdImrrMGAwKNGkev-VDZP6gSqPLxYwotoszV&e=04773666e8bff2ad6690a07f2e8e05fa&utm_source=ncgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ri_o_20_pm&n=4) Finally, [click here for the 2022 North Carolina Poll Observer Guide with RNC Poll Watcher Principles.](https://www.nc.gop/r?u=9g-hQKRcSqWoOTpvxkNQHxn3i1LqqUTzTetgJNEvAi1eVyzevVDXi_J0Mq4Dmc3QsXR2fpD_24FnURuL1RQE3zuO8l6kUknKvJ_k7w_gE2pm7kGkxg2Zu7oCtXAtBNBt&e=04773666e8bff2ad6690a07f2e8e05fa&utm_source=ncgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ri_o_20_pm&n=5) If you have any questions about the reporting form, the process for appointing observers, the recent ruling, or anything else, please contact me or anyone on the NCGOP’s Election Integrity team. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Electing progressives and expanding the Squad doesn’t come cheap. No
amount of money could compare to building progressive power and
transforming our country. It’s worth it, but we still have to raise that
money on our own — we’re talking hundreds of hours and lots of money that
we invest into our candidates.

We’re experiencing a fundraising dip and it’s really important that we
turn this ship around. We work year-round, cycle after cycle, so we have
to sustain fundraising 365 days a year. We can’t afford to fall behind 18
days before the election.

Our plan is to raise $15,000 by midnight tomorrow, which should get us

clean_body: We need a people-powered DNC to secure our majorities next month. | | Derek, because of the work of this grassroots team in 2020, the American people delivered a Democratic Congress and sent Joe Biden and me to the White House. And over these last few years, Democrats have delivered in big ways. But we have only 18 days left until Election Day to continue defending our progress. If we can rise up to support our party, we can build on the progress we’ve already made and then some. Can I count on you to make your first donation of the year today? Because grassroots donors supported the DNC in 2020, our party has been able to provide emergency relief to the American people, pass legislation to lower drug prices, pass the most significant gun violence prevention law in 30 years, and make the largest investment in our history to combat the climate crisis and deliver on environmental justice for people everywhere. We have done all of this and brought down the deficit by a record amount. We have paid for all of this without raising taxes on working people. We have done a lot, but we still have a lot more work that we’re ready to do. That is exactly why we need you. We need a people-powered DNC to secure our majorities next month and elect more Democrats at all levels. I’m so grateful to know I can count on you in these final 18 days. Keith Pekau

body:
The far-right’s goal is to destroy the community spaces that are so essential to our democracy.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221021-3521-header&t=1&akid=3521%2E2526796%2EMrWWDQ)
Almost every month for the last 4 years, Alexandria has held official town halls for NY-14 constituents to give updates on federal programs, her work in Congress, and to keep hearing about their needs.
And after New York finished its redistricting process this year, she also started holding a listening tour to meet people in new parts of the district.
These gatherings have always been productive, civil conversations about the important issues facing our community.**But in the last two weeks, these civic spaces have been interrupted by far-right actors, spewing hate.**
QAnon individuals have been showing up and aggressively disrupting many events across the country from queer poetry events to vaccine clinics. And on Wednesday, they came to our listening forum in Queens. They shouted anti-LGBTQ+ slurs and other profanities — attempting to drown out the constituents for whom the event was organized, and who had urgent questions around housing, inflation and more.
**The far-right’s goal is to destroy the community spaces that are so essential to our democracy — and to intimidate people who disagree with them into silence.** But we will keep listening to and meeting with our constituents. We’ll keep fostering democracy.
We won’t let them win.
But we need your help. [With just 18 days until the election, any amount you can chip in to the campaign helps us fight back against this hate. These actors are organized, and they wage aggressive disinformation campaigns in our district and across the country. The videos they shot at our listening forum were immediately twisted and amplified by Fox News and the vast right wing misinformation machine.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221021.kvfRP5&refcode=em20221021-3521-P_FND_EGR_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3521%2E2526796%2EMrWWDQ)

Thank you so much for your support. Together, I know we will help Alexandria keep fighting against the MAGA movement.
– Team AOC

body:
I need your help to cancel out the dirty, icky side of politics.
#
Hi Derek, Gisele here! ❤️
I just wanted to check in with you — after all, Election Day is only 18 days away.
João and I are feeling so inspired by all the incredible support we’ve seen in Cresco and across the state. As parents, we’re doing our best to allow the kids to join in on all the excitement too, while protecting them from the icky side of politics (like all of the attack ads and lies from Oz + the GOP super PACs).
**Which is what inspired me to share the #1 thing I want everyone to know about my husband’s campaign as this race heats up, Derek.**
We do NOT accept donations from gross corporate PACs or fossil fuel money.
We're running a clean + honest Democratic campaign that earns the support (and contributions!) of real people all across PA’s 67 counties. We fund our campaign this way because we believe it’s the only right way. Because when we say we're people-powered, we really mean it.
**[That’s why today, I’m excited to announce our next goal: Receiving 75,000 unique grassroots donations before John takes the debate stage Tuesday night. I need your help to show John that we have his back!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221021-3?amounts=5&refcode=em20221021-7829&refcode2=7829_434096_fM_Jf7&akid=7829%2E434096%2EfM_Jf7)**
**[Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221021-3?refcode=em20221021-7829&refcode2=7829_434096_fM_Jf7&akid=7829%2E434096%2EfM_Jf7)**
I know that Oz will spend the whole debate lying — either about his extremist views (he said all abortion is “murder”) or about my husband. I would even bet that he’ll attack João’s health, something a real doctor would _never_ do.
It’s another example of the dirty, icky side of politics, Derek. That’s why we’re launching this new goal — to help cancel out the bad side of politics with the amazing power of grassroots supporters.
And if you can’t donate, remember that even just reading this email makes you a part of this team! I would be so appreciative if you forwarded this email to your friends, family, and neighbors!
We hope being a part of this campaign makes you proud.
With love,
Gisele ❤️
Gisele Barreto Fetterman
Second Lady of Pennsylvania (SLoP)
P.S. Our digital and TV ads are working overtime to try and cancel out all of the lies being spread about João. **[Can you make a donation today to help us get more ads (and the truth) in front of voters?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221021-3?refcode=em20221021-7829&refcode2=7829_434096_fM_Jf7&akid=7829%2E434096%2EfM_Jf7)**

**_Recent polls are worrying:_**

[**I’m losing.**](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=51e2a38754e64a0fae1e5cdc575ee4ad&_e=ARu0l2B72TFxYXjjhwMpGrVhPJWo9JZGq6iwnz0j7KPw5qWXMCl1omMU2opTFc7dzULl7W_zpiAN6bawOpQX9yr25_jhP2U8apLyuGbDzOc7zXx09LMK8y2vJm6J0YpMLw8FA8xG_6FnVGfFqmMCAwwvoMnqj1VnchAMFQycigeZiBHptde_hWpCwoCxy18Gccqml8wvipNGRoWUHAqTcyNrtiWjUdM9-0OyeWXr5eX4TorGiBI3CSsQs-8XR8KnR5TBC7YHeTv0BUEAiXqlGivZU4qBiYZr8B4Jso_qr7vj7_GTS_xZkwyonssLgq8rYPZoG70-b7UDYnByaAcBgOV7tenWniNLTnxKVNxwGw1BsK2FCRPahMNk1KTM1mei2WnxLGu55WsNQUc9DhBCBFlGopsluEq0Qx7eNC0ZAnwC3_F1ro5b1_p9Sj-MSu_fcY0QX9rtHXsIrL35Lwk3L04Wn2ifUVmmMTtYnHLwlJo%3D)
And I’m not only losing against a Democrat opponent. **_I’m losing against a RADICAL LEFTIST who will strip away your freedom and advance Biden’s woke agenda._**
| [**HELP ME PUSH BACK**](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=51e2a38754e64a0fae1e5cdc575ee4ad&_e=ARu0l2B72TFxYXjjhwMpGrVhPJWo9JZGq6iwnz0j7KPw5qWXMCl1omMU2opTFc7dzULl7W_zpiAN6bawOpQX9yr25_jhP2U8apLyuGbDzOc7zXx09LMK8y2vJm6J0YpMLw8FA8xG_6FnVGfFqmMCAwwvoMnqj1VnchAMFQycigeZiBHptde_hWpCwoCxy18Gccqml8wvipNGRoWUHAqTcyNrtiWjUdM9-0OyeWXr5eX4TorGiBI3CSsQs-8XR8KnR5TBC7YHeTv0BUEAiXqlGivZU4qBiYZr8B4Jso_qr7vj7_GTS_xZkwyonssLgq8rYPZoG70-b7UDYnByaAcBgAVyGpOQ1E_HndQ0KdzgtQwzoLXzDNJ-_PuAYfXkgxS5dGCkMn5lTZTIEsSuM6jEbOLgEKX6lLvTQZwoHoNK7ESCoJ6MSoFb8vejfLnwp71yj03EJDxIfHZImn8hEWhWWLS2xyb1w6OucohtAYfHn0E%3D)
---

And I’m not the only one struggling. Republicans around the country are in the same boat - that even includes Ted Budd, who is fighting a key Senate race in North Carolina.

We need your help to move forward in these last weeks before the election. [**_We still have a chance at taking back the Senate, but only if you join us and support our work. Will I see your name on our list of supporters, Peter?_**](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=51e2a38754e64a0fae1e5cdc575ee4ad&_e=ARu0l2B72TFxYXjjhwMpGrVhPJWo9JZGq6iwnz0j7KPw5qWXMCl1omMU2opTFc7dzULl7W_zpiAN6bawOpQX9yr25_jhP2U8apLyuGbDzOc7zXx09LMK8y2vJm6J0YpMLw8FA8xG_6FnVGfFqmMCAwwvoMnqj1VnchAMFQycigeZiBHptde_hWpCwoCxy18Gccqml8wvipNGRoWUHAqTcyNrtiWjUdM9-0OyeWXr5eX4TorGiBI3CSsQs-8XR8KnR5TBC7YHeTv0BUEAiXqlGivZU4qBiYZr8B4Jso_qr7vj7_GTS_xZkwyonssLgq8rYPZoG70-b7UDYnByaAcBgCfcOPkKv2DWl7rCWcBukbPoIwTHj1MWhO_PajbkW8fIEqjD-HCUre4i80B006Jp2qGcKpO_epWcVdZqn0XfZXwoD9Llnt7IDEesq9axo-JHEpL9t7RtFZSe5OFE0WQsbCX4AyBH_jnfGYF1UiO9zu4%3D)

In a matter of days now, we will close our campaigns and it will all be up to the voters. But your vote is the LAST step in the process. I need your help before then.

[**_Can you help me reach the undecided voters in these last weeks?_**](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=51e2a38754e64a0fae1e5cdc575ee4ad&_e=ARu0l2B72TFxYXjjhwMpGrVhPJWo9JZGq6iwnz0j7KPw5qWXMCl1omMU2opTFc7dzULl7W_zpiAN6bawOpQX9yr25_jhP2U8apLyuGbDzOc7zXx09LMK8y2vJm6J0YpMLw8FA8xG_6FnVGfFqmMCAwwvoMnqj1VnchAMFQycigeZiBHptde_hWpCwoCxy18Gccqml8wvipNGRoWUHAqTcyNrtiWjUdM9-0OyeWXr5eX4TorGiBI3CSsQs-8XR8KnR5TBC7YHeTv0BUEAiXqlGivZU4qBiYZr8B4Jso_qr7vj7_GTS_xZkwyonssLgq8rYPZoG70-b7UDYnByaAcBgBpX_1lbKMP088Xot1e4QG1JbrKvPg63N0GaB38zPylSj2UEE8C0MVygtBTjuH10UFJP1eLTtUkaYXifWAIESBxBxuRJ4Nszx9EUis5gWaReKiYWGCw2sPXAU4RtDDMuUdwnG6C2szvghcEopJDbhnY%3D) We need them to know how radical my opponent really is. We cannot let the Democrats spread their lies and their radical message without pushing back.
[**HELP FIGHT BACK**](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=51e2a38754e64a0fae1e5cdc575ee4ad&_e=ARu0l2B72TFxYXjjhwMpGrVhPJWo9JZGq6iwnz0j7KPw5qWXMCl1omMU2opTFc7dzULl7W_zpiAN6bawOpQX9yr25_jhP2U8apLyuGbDzOc7zXx09LMK8y2vJm6J0YpMLw8FA8xG_6FnVGfFqmMCAwwvoMnqj1VnchAMFQycigeZiBHptde_hWpCwoCxy18Gccqml8wvipNGRoWUHAqTcyNrtiWjUdM9-0OyeWXr5eX4TorGiBI3CSsQs-8XR8KnR5TBC7YHeTv0BUEAiXqlGivZU4qBiYZr8B4Jso_qr7vj7_GTS_xZkwyonssLgq8rYPZoG70-b7UDYnByaAcBgLu_qnKSq7u_3xHwHZCtlA66zcxisqAvlIvhz8WCEy3hl7BcuJvm_Pe4ZsgO5HPkp1xLy3QIhkFPfkrYGFrJo_7C70GDEJFPgoqheC3GVuo_J5OnjiOgqpwGFworl5C9Xy5NIZbb9O4iJwCf5dv8v_Y%3D)

We came up just shy of our one day fundraising goal. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/56745b624643/what-happens-in-alaska-matters-nationwide-6112543?e=110fec2088)
---
| | [ ](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=0ca53ed7a5&e=110fec2088)

| | Friend,

We know our one day goal yesterday was ambitious. However, there are less than 3 weeks until Alaskans cast their ballots, so we're extending our deadline by one day.

**The dollars from this fundraising goal will go directly to spreading the word about Rep. Peltola and Sen. Murkowski’s campaigns.** But in order to stay on screens across the state, we need your support _today_.

These candidates have proven that they will prioritize Alaskans’ — and Americans’ — best interests, and they’ll put our future above their respective parties.

We’re about $2,000 short of our one day fundraising goal. _**With your support, we can secure necessary infrastructure funding, protect choice, and re-elect Congresswoman Peltola and Senator Murkowski**_.

**[](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=c01072060a&e=110fec2088)**
**[Will you chip in whatever you can before midnight so that we can continue our grassroots efforts up until Election Day?](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=2b96283d66&e=110fec2088)**
